title: Bigg Boss – The Common Man
summary:
Bigg Boss – The Common Man is a spin-off and pre-show of the Indian Tamil-language reality television show Bigg Boss. The pre-show involves selecting contestants that are not celebrities for the main show. The format of the show is based on the Telugu-language television show Bigg Boss Agnipariksha.
The show is hosted by former contestant Maya S. Krishnan whilst Oviya, Aari Arujunan and Raju Jeyamohan are the judges. The first season set to air from 16 August 2026. The winners will compete as contestants in the main Bigg Boss house.

articleSections.title: Announcement and digital auditions
articleSections.text: On 1 June 2026, the makers of the show released a promo where Vijay Sethupathi announced that commoners can participate in season 10 by visiting Jiostar's website. The initial call for applications was made on the VIJAY.JIOSTAR.COM website. Applicants had to register and upload a short video explaining why they deserve to be on the show.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The pre-show will premiere from 16 August 2026 until early September 2026 and will be streamed exclusively on JioHotstar.

articleSections.title: Host and judges
articleSections.text: Former Bigg Boss contestants are participated in the show as host and judges. *Oviya: Actress, contestant of Bigg Boss 1, she is a part of the pre-show's judging panel. *Aari Arujunan: Actor, winner of Bigg Boss 4. *Raju Jeyamohan: Actor, winner of Bigg Boss 5. *Maya S. Krishnan: Actress and host, second runner-up of Bigg Boss 7, She is now part of pre-show's host responsibilities.

episodesList.summary: Maya welcomes the final 50 contestants as Raju, Aari and Oviya take the judge's seat. A race for limited seats puts the contestants through a tense test.

episodesList.title: The Common Man: Stories That Stand Out
episodesList.summary: Shobha Indrakumar makes a powerful entry, while Muniyammal wins hearts. The contestants bring unique personalities to the stage putting the judges in a dilemma.

title: Vadhandhi season 2
summary:
Vadhandhi: The Mystery of Mani is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language mystery crime thriller streaming television series created, written and directed by Andrew Louis for Amazon Prime Video. It is the second installment of the Amazon Prime's Vadhandhi franchise. The show was produced by S. Guhapriya, S. Nandakumar, and Gowtham Selvaraj under the Wallwatcher Films banner and creatively produced by Pushkar–Gayathri.
The principal cast of the series includes M. Sasikumar, Yashwanth, Anagha, Aparna Das, Vivek Prasanna, Revathy Sharma and Arjun Nandhakumar. The series premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 7 August 2026 and consists of eight episodes.
plot: The series revolves around a police officer, SI Moosa Raaza, who is transferred to Madurai for his punishment. There, he solves a false political case. But he realizes that his success may have sent an innocent man to life imprisonment. He is drawn back into a tangled web of buried secrets.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced as a part of Amazon Prime Video's future slate of content in March 2026. The show is the second season of 2022's Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie with a different cast and story. Produced by S Guhapriya, S Nandakumar, and Gowtham Selvaraj under the Wallwatcher Films banner. Creative produced by Pushkar–Gayathri, who produced in the first season. The same director, Andrew Louis, who directed the first season, has returned to write and direct this season.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: On March 2025, Tamil film director and actor, M. Sasikumar was cast as police officer SI Moosa Raaza. This is his second role in a limited series after Nadu Center (2025). Actress Anagha and Aparna Das are playing important role. Actor Vivek Prasanna reprises his role from Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Amazon Prime Video released the series' first teaser on 19 March 2026. The series premiered on 7 August 2026, with all eight episodes released simultaneously. It was released in Tamil and dubbed in Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.

title: Pritam and Pedro
summary:
Pritam and Pedro is a 2026 Indian cybercrime comedy thriller television series created and produced by Rajkumar Hirani. It has been directed by Avinash Arun. The series began streaming from 3 July 2026 on JioHotstar.
This series marked Hirani's debut as a producer and creator in the streaming media. This series also marked the debut of Hirani's son Vir Hirani. Along with Arshad Warsi, Vir plays the lead role in the series.
plot: The series follows, Pritam, a young, tech-savvy coding expert, and Pedro, an old-school police officer in Goa. After Pritam is arrested following a dispute with the police regarding a lost tape recorder, he impresses them by quickly helping solve a major ATM theft using his cyber skills. As a result, Pedro drops him home. Later, Pedro is assigned a case of a lost phone of the Sports Ministers wife. He suspects their son, Vinny, but the minister and his wife refuse his investigation. Pedro decides to buy an identical phone and give it to her along with a fake thief. However the phone was already found in Vinny’s room. He is then transferred to IT cell of the department, a major punishment. He calls Pritam for help in one of his cases involving a killer committing suicide, in which they both manage to save everyone who was at risk, together. Then the story begins to reach a prime when Vinny, the son of the minister is seemingly missing and kidnapped.

articleSections.title: Cameo Appearance
articleSections.text: Sanjay Dutt as Himself * Virender Sehwag as Himself * Boman Irani as Professor Fonseca * Harshika Kewalramani as Chakachank Chandni

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Hirani mentioned in an interview that Pritam and Pedro would be a "fun series". He added that he got the idea for this series during the COVID-19 lockdown, when the Mumbai Cyber Cell had approached him to make a film on cybercrime. Later he met writer Amit Dubey, and after discussing over with him, the idea was finalized.
The trailer was released on 15 June 2026. During the premier, Arshad Warsi hinted that Sanjay Dutt could be seen playing a cameo in the series.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Pritam and Pedro began streaming on JioHotstar on 3 July 2026.

articleSections.title: [[Critical]] reception
articleSections.text:
Tanisha Bhattacharya of NDTV rated the series 4/5 stars and wrote "Arshad Warsi is excellent in Pritam & Pedro, while Vir Hirani leaves a lasting impression in his debut series." Shubhra Gupta of the Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and opined "Arshad Warsi-starrer show fits right within the Rajkumar Hirani universe in which the baddies come with sad backstories and mitigation." Poulomi Das of The Quint reviewed the series and opined "'Pritam and Pedro' has no granularity. It is cybercrime explained at the level of a school assembly."
Rahul Desai of the The Hollywood Reporter reviewed the swries and noted "A lot of the humour plays out like it expects audience reactions in the theatre, or even applause cues within the scenes. The performances are nothing to write — or type — home about. The supporting cast and cameos are largely ineffective." Sukanya Verma of Rediff rated the series 2/5 stars and wrote "Arshad Warsi can create an air of levity around anybody but Vir Hirani's stiff screen presence as Pritam Parkar has no vibe to match his peevish, pitiable Pedro Gonsalves, observes Sukanya Verma."
Anuj Kumar of The Hindu reviewed the series and highlighted "Bringing his magical touch to long-form storytelling, Rajkumar Hirani turns a cold, clinical cyber-thriller into a heartwarming buddy-cop comedy where old-school muscle beautifully collides with modern computer code." A critic from Bollywood Hungama rated the series 3.5/5 stars and noted "On the whole, PRITAM AND PEDRO works due to its nail-biting narrative, fast-paced storytelling, the relevance of its cybercrime backdrop and the dependable presence of Arshad Warsi. However, the cinematic liberties and a few rushed developments dent the impact to some extent."
Nandini Ramnath of the Scroll.in reviewed the series and wrote "Fortunately, the series is tight enough to wrap up its themes and position itself for a second season of crime-solving that needs brawn, brains and a big heart." Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated the series 3.5/5 stars and opined "The show’s biggest limitation lies in its predictability. Certain twists feel familiar, and some conflicts are resolved a little too conveniently. Still, these flaws do little to dilute the show’s overall charm. Overall, it is an entertaining blend of humour, suspense and heart that makes for a thoroughly enjoyable binge."
Abhishek Srivastava of Moneycontrol rated the series 3.5/5 stars and noted "‘Pritam and Pedro’ is a simple and warm cybercrime story that never feels heavy or complicated and keeps things easy to follow. Powered by strong performances and light humour, it turns into an easy, feel-good watch." Shweta Keshri of India Today rated the series 3.5/5 stars and wrote "The series, featuring Arshad Warsi and Vir Hirani, pairs a cyber-savvy young man with an old-school officer on a kidnapping case. The series is a light-hearted buddy-cop drama set in Goa, blending simple cyber crime with humour and heartfelt moments."
Raja Sen of Mint reviewed the series and wrote "In his new series ‘Pritam and Pedro’, Rajkumar Hirani is again oversimplifying things and talking down to his audience." Devesh Sharma of Filmfare reviewed the series and opined "It entertains, makes you laugh, keeps you guessing and quietly reminds you how vulnerable we have all become in the online age. Backed by superb writing and wonderfully lived-in performances, it marks a confident and thoroughly enjoyable OTT debut for Rajkumar Hirani." Shreyanka Mazumdar of News18 rated the series 2.5/5 stars and noted "Pritam and Pedro is an entertaining cybercrime thriller that doesn't always hit the mark, but Arshad Warsi and Vir Hirani's chemistry makes this six-episode series a breezy binge."

episodesList.summary: Digging into Vinny's secret online game, Pedro and Pritam uncover a digital maze. A subtle discovery rattles the family, as Pritam's past creeps closer than he expects.

episodesList.title: Catch Me If You Can
episodesList.summary: Pedro wants to catch a criminal, but Pritam wants to track a mind. The hunt flips, turning the case into a cat-and-mouse game where Pedro isn't sure who is chasing whom.

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Time's up! Is Martin really their guy? Pritam, Pedro and the entire police squad better act quick… before Vinny loses his life.

plotHtml: The series follows, Pritam, a young, tech-savvy coding expert, and Pedro, an old-school police officer in Goa. After Pritam is arrested following a dispute with the police regarding a lost tape recorder, he impresses them by quickly helping solve a major ATM theft using his cyber skills. As a result, Pedro drops him home. Later, Pedro is assigned a case of a lost phone of the Sports Ministers wife. He suspects their son, Vinny, but the minister and his wife refuse his investigation. Pedro decides to buy an identical phone and give it to her along with a fake thief. However the phone was already found in Vinny’s room. He is then transferred to IT cell of the department, a major punishment. He calls Pritam for help in one of his cases involving a killer committing suicide, in which they both manage to save everyone who was at risk, together. Then the story begins to reach a prime when Vinny, the son of the minister is seemingly missing and kidnapped.

title: Lingam
summary:
Lingam is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language crime drama television series created by Prasanth Pandiyaraj for JioHotstar. The series is inspired by the life of V. Lingam, a notorious gangster from Kanyakumari district from 1987 to 1995.The series is written and directed by Lakshmi Saravanakumar and produced by Raadhika Srinivasan and B. Srinivasan under the banner of Vikatan Televistas.
It follows the dark transformation of a talented Kabaddi champion who is falsely accused of murder on the brink of his athletic success, forcing him into a violent and dangerous underworld. The series stars Kathir, Divyabharathi, Shahir and Poornima Ravi in lead roles.It was released on JioHotstar for its label Hotstar Specials on 26 June 2026 and declared a Streaming Blockbuster.
plot: Muthulingam "Lingam", a brilliant kabaddi champion whose ambition of joining the police force is crushed by a tragic, unjust incident. Wrongfully accused, he is cast into a ruthless criminal underworld. Driven by intense grief and vengeance following the murder of his mentor, Chellapandian, Lingam targets the powerful antagonist, Samiyappan. His path takes a dangerous turn when he attempts to protect a young couple, thrusting him into a massive crisis that forces him into hiding.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Lingam was written and directed by Lakshmi Saravanakumar, who based the series on the life of V. Lingam, a notorious gangster from Kanyakumari district, while fictionalising several incidents for dramatic purposes. Filmmaker Prasanth Pandiyaraj, known for Vilangu, joined the project as its presenter.The series was produced by Vikatan Televistas for Hotstar Specials and was officially announced as part of the platform's slate of 25 Tamil original productions in December 2025.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In December 2025, Kathir was announced to portray the titular character, Lingam. Divyabharathi was cast as the female lead, while Shahir, Poornima Ravi, Bose Venkat, Nikhila Sankar, and Vimal joined the supporting cast.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first trailer of Lingam was released on 6 June 2026, showcasing the transformation of an aspiring police officer and kabaddi player into a feared gangster after being falsely accused of murder.The series premiered on JioHotstar on 26 June 2026 in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi and Bengali.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Sree of OTT Release gave 4/5 stars and wrote that, "Overall Lingam is a crime drama with good performances, a well-paced story and plenty of suspense. If you are looking for a Tamil series that’s exciting and has a lot of action, emotion and mystery you should watch *Lingam*.Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "Long gone are the days when OTTs were a breath of fresh air and served as a medium for alternative storytelling. With digital viewership more or less reaching the saturation point across many platforms, it is not surprising that the idea is to consolidate rather than push the bar. Lingam is just a byproduct of that, needlessly reviving a brand of cinema that has already fallen out of favour with audiences in recent years. Even if rural gangster dramas are your forte, find a better way to kill time than watching Lingam".
Jeevaganesh. P of Ananda Vikatan wrote that, "Even though it changes direction in the second half, 'Lingam' is definitely worth watching as it is a good start and thriller for a gangster movie".

title: Tu Hi Re Dil Mein
summary: Tu Hi Re Dil Mein (transl. You Are In My Heart) is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series which premiered on Zee TV on 15 June 2026 and stream digitally on ZEE5.  Produced by Films and Shots Production, the series stars Priyanshi Yadav, Abrar Qazi and Simran Rawal. It is an official remake of the Malayalam TV series  Mizhi Randilum of Zee Keralam.
plot: Believed to bring luck, Vrinda marries her dream man, Sanjay, who loves Swati. Living in his home as a caretaker, Vrinda faces silent sacrifices and soul ties, uncertain if fate will ever choose her.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Priyanshi Yadav as Vrinda * Abrar Qazi as Sanjay * Simran Rawal as Swati

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Abrar Qazi was confirmed to play the male lead, Sanjay. Priyanshi Yadav was selected to portray Vrindha. Simran Rawal was cast to play Swati, making her television debut as a lead actor.

articleSections.title: Premiere
articleSections.text: The show was put on hold for some time from March dut to the lukewarm response from the audience for the first teaser and title dispute with Ekta Kapoor. Makers spend time in developing the love triangle and Sanjay's dilemma tracks. After the delay, the show premiered on 15 June 2026, replacing Saru.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: The show opened with a low BARC TRP of 0.7 in week 24 of 2026.

articleSections.title: Title dispute
articleSections.text:
When Zee TV announced the title as "Pavitra Rishta" in December 2025, the creator of the 2009 iconic TV series by the same name, Ekta Kapoor slammed the makers for using the same title. She shared a sharp, critical note on her Instagram stating:
After the intense backlash from fans and producer Ekta, the channel changed the title to "Tu Hi Re Dil Mein" in April 2026.

articleSections.title: Director opted out
articleSections.text: In June 2026, director Ameet Guptha went public with social media evidence. He shared screenshots proving his name had been entirely chopped from the first episode’s on-screen credits despite he dedicated six months to pre-production and filming the initial episodes. Broadcaster ZEE Network officially withdrew its internal "rotational credit" policy in July after intense pressure from the Screenwriters Association.

reception:
Hollywood Reporter India reviewer Rahul Desai called the series "does well to stay rooted in the anatomy of crime in a pre-technology and early-forensics era." The Indian Express reviewer Shubhra Gupta stated "What’s nice is the way the writers show us that a child can be inherently depraved and violent." NDTV reviewer Tanisha Bhattacharya stated the series boils blood.
Rediff.com reviewer Deepa Gahlot felt "excessive violence is disturbing", but praised Ali Fazal's performance as "one of his best performances so far." Renuka Vyavahare of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars and said that "Raakh is unsettling, disturbing, and difficult to watch at times, but undeniably important viewing." India Today reviewer Vineeta Kumar called the series as "gritty, atmospheric and impeccably performed."
Bollywood Hungama critics rated it 3.5/5 stars and writes that "RAAKH is a hard-hitting and disturbing series that works due to its gripping narrative, atmospheric treatment and strong performances." Anuj Kumar of The Hindu observed that "Raakh’ is an immersive investigative crime drama that sifts through Delhi’s lost innocence."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Raakh has more meaning than one. Given how we continue to struggle as a country, we are literally burning to the ashes." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in writes in her review that "Raakh doesn’t give a proper sense of the time taken to catch the killers, nor of the way in which time itself might have moved more slowly all those decades ago." Rachit Gupta writing for Filmfare gave 4 stars out of 5 and stated that "What makes Raakh truly rare is its genre obscurity. It arrives as a procedural, operates as a thriller and lands as horror."
Cinema Express reviewer BH Harsh rated the series 4/5 stars and writes "the makers also show resistance at many moments." The New Indian Express reviewer rated the series 4 out off 5 stars.
The Quint reviewer felt the series "doesn’t give enough to the viewers to chew on." Kabir Singh Bhandari of The Free Press Journal stated that the series "is not an easy watch."

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: Raakh generated controversy after viewers and commentators noted that several characters inspired by real people in the 1978 Ranga–Billa case had their religious and caste identities changed in the adaptation. Among the reported changes were the replacement of the Sikh perpetrators with fictional Hindu characters, the portrayal of a fictional Muslim police officer in place of a real Hindu officer, and the replacement of journalist Prabha Dutt and civilian Babulal with fictional Muslim characters. Critics argued that these changes altered the historical record, while others defended them as creative liberties typical of fictional adaptations.

title: Bareilly Ke Bacchan
summary: Bareilly Ke Bacchan is an Indian Hindi-language family drama television series that premiered on 8 June 2026 on Colors TV  and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by AORAA Pictures, it stars Pravisht Mishra, Ramneek Kataria, and Kinshuk Mahajan. It is a remake of the Tamil show Ayyanar Thunai.
plot:
The series is set in the town of Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, and revolves around the eccentric, dysfunctional, and all-male Bacchan household. Led by the stubborn family patriarch, Ajab Singh Bacchan (Yashpal Sharma), the household comprises his four unfiltered sons who have lived for years entirely devoid of any female presence or influence. The brothers each represent a unique layer of the chaotic domestic ecosystem: Ganga (Kinshuk Mahajan), the soft-spoken eldest brother who acts as the makeshift mother-figure; Krishna (Pravisht Mishra), a charming taxi driver on a constant quest to find true love; Satluj (Ansh Manuja), an explosive and hot-headed young man; and Mahi (Sachin Jeet Singh), the youngest of the pack.
The narrative kicks off when Krishna crosses paths with Sangam (Ramneek Kataria), an ambitious, clear-headed college topper whose dreams of pursuing her education and career constantly clash with her traditional father’s rigid plans to marry her off. Sangam is initially arranged to marry an arrogant man named Vicky, who dismisses her career ambitions. Krishna, falling in a one-sided love with Sangam, takes up a job as Vicky's driver to stay close to her and protect her interests.
Through a twist of fate and the collapse of her initial arranged alliance, Sangam ends up marrying the carefree Krishna. The core conflict of the show explores the ultimate cultural and domestic clash when Sangam—a strong-willed, goal-oriented modern woman—enters the unkempt, rowdy Bacchan house as the first daughter-in-law. The plot follows Sangam's daily struggles to navigate a household of men completely unaccustomed to living with a woman, as she attempts to bring order to their unruly lives while fighting to keep her own personal ambitions alive.

title: Brown
summary:
Brown is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language psychological thriller web series directed by Abhinay Deo and produced by Zee Studios. It is based on City of Death, a 2016 novel by Abheek Barua, with the screenplay written by Diggi Sisodia, Sunayana Kumari, and Mayukh Ghosh. It stars Karisma Kapoor as a Kolkata detective, alongside Surya Sharma, Jisshu Sengupta, Soni Razdan and Ajinkya Deo. The series premiered on ZEE5 on 5 June 2026.
Set in Kolkata, the series follows Rita Brown, an Anglo-Indian detective with the Kolkata Police Force who investigates the murder of a teenager from a prominent family while dealing with alcoholism and personal trauma. In 2023, it was selected for Berlinale Series Market Selects, the first Indian web series chosen for that programme.
plot: Rita Brown is a detective with the Kolkata Police Force from the city's Anglo-Indian community. She is a recovering alcoholic assigned to investigate the murder of a teenager from a well-connected Kolkata family. Jisshu Sengupta plays a psychiatrist connected to the investigation.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 2 stars out of 5 and writes that "And in its first couple of episodes, this 7-episode show, which has been hanging fire for a while, does grab our attention." Deepa Gahlot writing for the Rediff.com gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and noted that "Karisma Kapoor makes a powerful return to the screen in Brown, a compelling series." Shreyas Pande writing for The Hindu observes that "Director Abhinay Deo crafts an intriguing world of characters only to later let monotony set in as the screenplay doesn’t take any creative leaps".
Prachi Arya of India Today gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Brown works best as a psychological crime drama that relies more on its characters and mood than on shock value. Its haunting Kolkata setting, strong performances and well-paced mystery keep you invested throughout, even if the constant emphasis on grief and trauma can feel a little repetitive at times." Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated it 3.5/5 stars and writes that "Watch it if you enjoy atmospheric slow-burn crime thrillers that focus more on complex characters and psychological depth than traditional whodunnit twists."
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in felt that "Brown follows the beats of crime thrillers to a fault, it benefits from well-written characters with defined arcs and solid scenes. The show is well-produced, appropriately grim-looking and gripping. The dialogue is mostly in Hindi with lashings of Bengali and English." Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India desrcibe it as a "A good-looking but banal crime thriller."
Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost gave 4 stars out of 5 and writes that "Karisma Kapoor’s Brown has the magnetic ability to put you in deep thought. Each episode is long and so immersive that it will not only emotionally drain you out but will also teach you how to deal with grief." Monica Yadav writing for Hindustan Times rated it 3/5 stars and said that "If you love slow-burn, atmospheric noir or want to see a career-redefining performance from Karisma Kapoor, Brown is worth your time." Shreyanka Mazumdar of News 18 gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and priase the performance saying that "Karisma Kapoor delivers one of the finest performances of her career in Brown, a dark and absorbing crime thriller."

articleSections.title: Background
articleSections.text:
Zee Studios developed Brown from Abheek Barua's novel City of Death (2016) over roughly two years before its international debut.
At the Berlinale, Karisma Kapoor told Variety that the character Rita Brown appealed to her precisely because she was far from her earlier work: "flawed, but human," and a role that required dropping the glamour of her film career. The series also features playback singer Shaan in his acting debut.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Abhinay Deo, known for directing Delhi Belly (2011) and the Indian adaptation of 24, directed Brown. The screenplay was written by Diggi Sisodia, Sunayana Kumari, and Mayukh Ghosh, adapted from Barua's novel. Suri Gopalan created the series in collaboration with Barua; Zee Studios produced it.
The series is set and shot in Kolkata, whose architecture and street atmosphere inform its neo-noir visual tone.

title: The Pyramid Scheme
summary: The Pyramid Scheme is a 2026 Amazon Prime Video original Hindi-language television series written by Akshendra Mishra and directed by Ashish R Shukla and Shreyansh Pandey. The series stars Paramvir Cheema, Ranvir Shorey, Aanjjan Srivastav, Shekhar Suman, Ashish Raghav, Alfiya Jafri, Akhilendra Mishra, Smita Bansal, Indresh Malik, Sushant Singh.
reception:
The Times of India reviewer Dhaval Roy stated "The characterisations across the board are convincing," India Today reviewer Pritinanda Behera opined that the series "does slow down a bit around the middle."
Deepa Gahlot of Scroll.in writes that "The eight-part show swings wildly between farce and family melodrama, reaching the kernel of the plot rather late – how get-rich-quick swindles work, and how the perpetrators get away." Prathyush Parasuraman writing for The Hollywood Reporter India stated that "This pyramid scheme flatlines quickly, and A Silly and Soulless Stab At Scam Culture."
Abhishek Srivastava of Moneycontrol gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "There is a good series hidden somewhere inside ‘The Pyramid Scheme.’ What appears on screen is watchable enough, but it never becomes as compelling or insightful as its premise promises. Jaya Dwivedie of India TV also rated it 3/5 stars and writes that "The Pyramid Scheme may not become a cult series like TVF's Panchayat or Gullak, but it is definitely worth watching once." Sumit Rajguru of Times Now also gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "The Pyramid Scheme is a worthy watch for those looking for something unique and light-hearted. The series has its standout moments that are not to be missed."

summary: Hastinapur Ke Veer is an Indian mythological television series produced by Peninsula Pictures which premiered on 2 June 2026 on Sony SAB. It stars Athar Khan, Subhash Singh, Urva Savaliya, Harit Gabani and Mayank Yadav.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text: Five noble brothers unite with courage and righteousness to battle the ruthless forces of ambition and injustice that threaten their kingdom, testing their bonds through sacrifice and unwavering devotion to dharma.

episodesList.title: Veers Save Gajanan
episodesList.summary: A heartwarming beginning awaits as the young Pandavas unite to save Gajanan from danger.

episodesList.title: Sahadev’s Danger
episodesList.summary: In a sudden moment, Sahadev falls into a deep well, and a scared Nakul runs to tell their mother. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Veers Meet Bhishma Pitamah
episodesList.summary: The Veers rescue Sahdev and come face-to-face with Bhishma Pitamah. What happens now?

episodesList.title: Pandavas Enter Hastinapur
episodesList.summary: As Bhishma Pitama brings Kunti and the Pandavas to Hastinapur, how will Duryodhana react to their arrival?

episodesList.title: Mama Shakuni Triggers Duryodhana
episodesList.summary: Will Duryodhana follow Mama Shakuni's advice and unite with his brothers to appear stronger than the Pandavas?

episodesList.title: Veers Face Duryodhana
episodesList.summary: A royal encounter turns uneasy as the Veers confront Duryodhana. How will they handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Matwala Haathi
episodesList.summary: Duryodhana's sinister plot puts Hastinapur's safety and honour at risk. Can the Pandavas handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Mama Shakuni's Clever Advice
episodesList.summary: As fear clouds Duryodhana's mind, can Mama Shakuni's words help him regain his confidence?

episodesList.title: Dhritarashtra's Promise To Duryodhana
episodesList.summary: Will Dhritarashtra's words strengthen Duryodhana's hopes, or deepen existing rivalries?

episodesList.title: The Gurukul Decision
episodesList.summary: As the Pandavas' future is discussed, what tension begins to emerge in Hastinapur?

episodesList.title: Bheem And Duryodhana Face Off
episodesList.summary: Bheem and Duryodhana face off in a powerful wrestling match, leaving everyone wondering who will come out stronger.

episodesList.title: Duryodhana's Thirst For Throne
episodesList.summary: Mama Shakuni suggests Duryodhana that the throne demands a sacrifice. What will he sacrifice for the crown?

episodesList.title: Khel Diwas
episodesList.summary: Duryodhana reaches out to the Pandavas in friendship, but with Mama Shakuni around, nothing is ever as it seems. What sinister game is Shakuni playing now?

episodesList.title: Bheem’s Haunting Dream
episodesList.summary: Is Bheem's endless nightmare a warning of something to come, or a clue from the past?

episodesList.title: Mama Shakuni's Wicked Scheme
episodesList.summary: Mama Shakuni plays a risky card that could alter everything. What's next?

episodesList.title: Duryodhan’s Plot Against Bheem
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan tricks Bheem with poisoned kheer, and after Bheem falls unconscious, he throws him into the water.

episodesList.title: Bhima’s Sudden Disappearance
episodesList.summary: Bheem is nowhere to be found, and questions keep mounting. What awaits him, and who will uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Bheema Entrapped In Naaglok
episodesList.summary: As the Pandavs search for Bheem near the river, he finds himself trapped in the world of snakes. How will the mighty warrior navigate this dangerous underworld and find a way back home?

episodesList.title: Battle In Naaglok
episodesList.summary: As Bheem faces the challenge in Naaglok, everyone wonders if he will win or will Naaglok be stronger?

episodesList.title: Bheem Learns Of Duryodhana’s Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Bheem learns the shocking truth in Naaglok that Duryodha poisoned him and threw him into the river. now what will Bheem do next?

episodesList.title: Arjuna’s Quest For Truth
episodesList.summary: Arjun sets out to find who pushed Bheem into the water. Will he succeed in uncovering the truth?

episodesList.title: Bhishma Senses Duryodhana’s Deception
episodesList.summary: Bhishma Pitamah senses that Duryodhan is hiding something about Bheem's sudden disappearance. Will he finally reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Kunti Misses Bheem
episodesList.summary: Lost in Bheem's memories, Kunti feels he has returned when she sees Duryodhan, but soon realizes it isn't him.

episodesList.title: Hastinapur Awaits Bheem’s Return
episodesList.summary: People of Hastinapur keep talking about Bheem's return, but now everyone believes he is gone. what will happen next?

episodesList.title: Bheem’s Return Sparks Fear In Duryodhana
episodesList.summary: Bheem's unexpected return shocks everyone in Hastinapur. While Bhishma Pitamah feels relieved and asks him what happened, Duryodhan is gripped by fear, worried that his dark secret may finally be exposed.

episodesList.title: Duryodhana’s Crime Exposed By Bheem
episodesList.summary: After Bheem reveals that Duryodhan threw him into the water and that he spent many days in Naaglok, how will the Pandavas react, and what will they do to make Duryodhan pay for his actions?

episodesList.title: Bheem's Powerful Revenge
episodesList.summary: With his strength greater than ever, Bheem is ready to take revenge on Duryodhan. but does Duryodhan have any chance of saving himself?

episodesList.title: Bheem's Clever Deception
episodesList.summary: Bheem saves Duryodhan's life but pretends to be injured. As Bhishma Pitamah suspects Bheem is hiding the truth, will his secret be exposed?

episodesList.title: Dhritarashtra Faces His Son’s Betrayal
episodesList.summary: After Mahaganga reveals the truth that Duryodhan poisoned Bheem and threw him into the river, will his father finally punish him for his cruel actions?

episodesList.title: Kunti Confronts A Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Kunti learns the shocking truth that Duryodhan poisoned Bheem and threw him into the Ganga to kill him.

episodesList.title: Will Duryodhan Apologize
episodesList.summary: Even after his mother asks him to seek forgiveness from Kunti and Bheem, will Duryodhan finally put aside his pride and apologize?

episodesList.title: Kunti's Lessons For The Pandavas
episodesList.summary: In the jungle, Kunti teaches the Pandavas valuable life lessons, the true values of humanity, and how to face every challenge with strength and wisdom.

episodesList.title: Guru Dronacharya's First Lesson
episodesList.summary: When Duryodhan throws the ball into a deep well, Guru Dronacharya steps in and shows everyone that even the impossible can be made possible.

episodesList.title: The Search For Guru Dronacharya
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas begin their journey to Kamadam Mountain in search of Guru Dronacharya, but will they successfully reach their guru?

episodesList.title: The Pandavas' Tough Test
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas are trapped in a magical illusion they cannot break. How will they find a way out?

episodesList.title: The Pandavas' Masterstroke
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas use their intelligence and strategy to escape the Rakshasa's trap and defeat him with their clever plan.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan secretly teams up with a Rakshasa and sets a dangerous plan in motion against the Pandavas.

episodesList.title: Guru Dronacharya's Gurukul
episodesList.summary: Guru Dronacharya brings the Pandavas and Kauravas to the Gurukul, where they begin their journey of learning discipline, knowledge, and warfare.

episodesList.title: Arjun Gets Punished
episodesList.summary: When Arjun arrives late, Dronacharya refuses to listen to any excuses and punishes him. But who was responsible for locking the door and causing his delay?

episodesList.title: Arjun Won't Give Up
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas ask Arjun to come down, but he refuses, saying he must complete Dronacharya's punishment. How will the Pandavas save him now?

episodesList.title: Gurudev's Tough Teaching
episodesList.summary: After finishing his punishment, Arjun and the others feel hungry, but Gurudev reminds them that hunger is their enemy and offers only fruits for their meal.

episodesList.title: Guru Dev Learns Duryodhan's Plan
episodesList.summary: Guru Dev discovers that the Kauravas have hired outsiders to do their work while they relax, all to make the Pandavas look inferior. What action will Guru Dev take now?

episodesList.title: The Search For Vanpal Begins
episodesList.summary: Believing that Vanpal destroyed the Gurukul, the Pandavas and Kauravas set out to find him and uncover who Vanpal really is.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan’s New Plan
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan feels that Gurudev only favors the Pandavas and decides to win his attention. Will Duryodhan succeed in his plan?

episodesList.title: Gurudev’s Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Pitamah visits the Gurukul to meet the children, but Gurudev asks him to leave, saying he wants to raise them with the right values and proper education.

episodesList.title: Ashwathama’s Arrival At The Gurukul
episodesList.summary: As Ashwathama arrives at the Gurukul, Gurudevi welcomes him, but Gurudev refuses to let him take part in the ritual, saying discipline matters more than appearances. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Gurudev’s Test For The Students
episodesList.summary: Gurudev warns the students that weapons are not a game and must be used with respect and responsibility. When they ask how they can prove their worth, will Gurudev put them through a challenging test?

episodesList.title: The Gurukul Challenge
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas confidently announce that Arjun will emerge victorious in the challenge against Duryodhan. Will Duryodhan prove them wrong and turn the tide in his favor?

episodesList.title: Gurudev's Lesson On True Success
episodesList.summary: By using his intellect, Arjun succeeds in Gurudev's challenge; however, Gurudev explains that true achievement stems from wisdom, moral values, and discipline, not simply from finding the fastest solution.

episodesList.title: Gurudev's Strict Punishment For Arjun
episodesList.summary: Gurudev punishes Arjun for breaking the rules and bans him from attending his classes for seven days. What will the Pandavas do now?

episodesList.title: Gurudev's Lesson For Duryodhan
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan complains that the Pandavas are secretly teaching Arjun. But Gurudev reminds him to focus on himself, saying that while Arjun has been kept away from the class, he has not been kept away from knowledge.

episodesList.title: The Path Of Bhiksha
episodesList.summary: Gurudev sends Pandavas and Kauravas for bhiksha, where they witness life's struggles. Will this journey change their perspective forever?

episodesList.title: Gurudev's Greatest Test
episodesList.summary: As the Pandavas learn profound life lessons through their bhiksha journey, Gurudev prepares a legendary archery test that will reveal the true master among his disciples.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Ultimate Test
episodesList.summary: While others learn in class, Arjun learns through hardship. Will he pass Gurudev's legendary bird's-eye challenge?

episodesList.title: Arjun's Focused Aim
episodesList.summary: Gurudev tests Arjun's focus as he perfectly targets the parrot's eye. Impressed by his skill, Duryodhan's jealousy sparks a conflict.

episodesList.title: Eklavya Seeks Guru
episodesList.summary: Arjun hones his archery skills as Duryodhan's push fuels rivalry among the princes. Meanwhile, Eklavya seeks Dronacharya's guidance.

episodesList.title: Eklavya Faces Danger
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan's act against Arjun angers the Pandavas, while Eklavya's journey to meet Dronacharya turns dangerous when lions attack. Will he survive?

episodesList.title: Arjun And Vikarna
episodesList.summary: Ashwathama trains Arjun while Vikarna strives to outshine him. Meanwhile, Eklavya faces a tough challenge on his quest to meet Dronacharya.

episodesList.title: Will Ashwathama Leave Arjun?
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan's lies drive a wedge between Ashwathama and Arjun. Will their friendship survive, or is this the end of their bond?

episodesList.title: Duryodhan's Jungle Trap
episodesList.summary: Driven by revenge, Duryodhan sends the Pandavas and Ashwathama into a dangerous forest through deceit. Will the Pandavas escape Duryodhan's deadly trap?

episodesList.title: Pichhach Attacks Pandavas
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas face a deadly Pichhach attack in the jungle. Can they escape its trap and uncover Duryodhan's evil plan?

episodesList.title: Ashwathama’s Tough Punishment
episodesList.summary: Gurudev punishes Ashwathama for leaving the Gurukul. Duryodhan tries to turn him against the Pandavas. Will their friendship survive?

episodesList.title: Arjun Masters His Senses
episodesList.summary: Arjun takes control of his senses while the Pandavas unite to fight the Pichhachas and free the jungle from their threat.

episodesList.title: Pishaach Attack The Pandavas
episodesList.summary: Arjun defeats a Pishaach attacking the Gurukul with Gangajal, while Duryodhan schemes against the Pandavas through Ashwathama.

episodesList.title: Arjun’s Heroic Transformation
episodesList.summary: Gurudev gives Arjun a bow and declares that he is no longer just a prince of Hastinapur, but a true hero who fights for others.

title: Sairaab
summary: Sairaab is an Indian Hindi-language musical romantic drama television series airing on StarPlus from 2 June 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Leena Gangopadhyay under Magic Moments Motion Pictures, the series stars Madirakshi Mundle and Krishna Kaul (replaced Rohit Chandel). It is an official remake of Star Suvarna's Kannada series Manasella Neene.
plot: The story follows Dr. Nayanika Roy, a single working mother and Ishaan Ganguly, a celebrity rockstar, as they navigate the challenges of love, family and relationships.
reception: In its opening week, the show recorded 0.7 TRP in week 23 of 2026 and had a household reach of 1.4 TVR. The next week, it clocked at a rating of 0.8

articleSections.text: Madirakshi Mundle and Rohit Chandel were selected to play Noyonika and Ishaan. Mohit Jaswani was cast as Rohan Basu. In July 2026, Actors Sagar Parekh, Avinash Mishra, and Aashay Mishra were approached for the role of Ishaan but Krishna Kaul was finalized to replace Rohit Chandel due to Chandel's POCSO Case.

episodesList.title: Meet Dr. Nayanika!
episodesList.summary: Single mother Dr. Noyonika lives a serene life with her daughter, Ujjayani. Then enters pop star Ishaan, reigniting her world, albeit with uncalled chaos!

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Surprise for Ujjaini
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini urges everyone to skip her birthday planning and confides in Indranil to celebrate Rohan's instead. Nayanika stuns her with unexpected tickets to the Sairaab concert.

episodesList.title: Ishaan's Memorable Performance
episodesList.summary: Ishaan makes a grand entry at the concert and leaves everyone mesmerised with his performance. After the show, he invites Nayanika into his van for an autograph as she thanks him.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini staggers home drunk, and Nayanika slaps her in fury. Regretful, Ujjaini apologises and promises Nayanika she'll never make the same mistake again.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Meets Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Ishaan tells Nayanika that it is one of the most special days of his life. Later, after a hospital checkup, he surprises her by inviting her to lunch.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Opens Up to Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Sara encourages Maria to reconnect with Ishaan after his successful concert in Kolkata. Ishaan opens up to Nayanika about his deep bond with his mother, Maria.

episodesList.title: Angana Confronts Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Angana complains to Nayanika about Ujjaini's rude behaviour in the classroom. Mesmerized by memories of Nayanika, Ishaan pours his emotions into a song.

episodesList.title: Dinner Invitation for Ishaan
episodesList.summary: Nayanika is haunted by Indranil's confession about Angana. When Ishaan urgently wishes to meet her, Nayanika invites him for a dinner at her home.

episodesList.title: Ishaan, Nayanika's Poetic Romance
episodesList.summary: A rainy day brings Ishaan and Nayanika closer as he turns her poem into a song and offers friendship. Later, Nayanika helps him when his car breaks down.

episodesList.title: Ishaan Meets Nayanika's Family
episodesList.summary: Nayanika invites Ishaan for a special dinner with her family. As everyone warmly welcomes Ishaan, Ujjaini reveals a major truth about Nayanika's past marriage.

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Shreya starts doubting Nayanika's motives for hiding the truth from the family. Nayanika firmly pleads with Ishaan to stay away and never contact her again.

episodesList.title: Nayanika's Concern for Ishaan
episodesList.summary: Nayanika grows worried about Ishaan and feels guilty for being rude to him. She insists she can't stay away and recites the poem she wrote for Ishaan.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini's Unexpected Encounter
episodesList.summary: Ujjaini is shocked to find Nayanika in Ishaan's hotel room and asks him to attend the college freshers party. Indranil questions Nayanika about her absence at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini's Heartfelt Apology to Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Overcome with regret, Ujjaini tearfully apologises to Nayanika for doubting her. She then reveals Sesho's love for her and urges Nayanika to meet him.

episodesList.title: Ujjaini Confronts Nayanika
episodesList.summary: Nayanika stays home for Ujjaini and Romeo's exams while the others decide to visit the Puri Jagannath Temple. Ujjaini questions Nayanika about Ishaan's intention in calling her.

episodesList.title: Nayanika Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Nayanika's eyes well up as she watches Ishaan's concert on television. Tension rises during the family Puja when Nayanika is prevented from taking part in the rituals.

episodesList.title: Nayanika-Ishaan's Unspoken Emotions
episodesList.summary: At Ujjaini's insistence, Nayanika decides to attend the fresher's party. As the celebrations begin, she and Ishaan cross paths, stirring emotions they struggle to hide.

episodesList.title: Ishaan's Melodious Performance
episodesList.summary: At the event, Ishaan steals the spotlight with a heartwarming singing performance. As the audience praises his song lyrics, he reveals that Nayanika wrote them.

title: Brothers and Sisters
summary:
Brothers and Sisters is an Indian Tamil-language romantic family comedy drama television series, which is an spiritual successor of the web series Uppu Puli Kaaram (2024).This series is directed by Chidambaram Manivannan for JioHotstar.The story revolves around a close-knit but secret-laden family as a brother and his three sisters embark on a hilarious, emotional mission to manage their father.
The principal characters of the series include Bose Venkat, Gayathri Shastry, Pramodini Pammi, Nikhila Sankar, Luthuf, Shravnitha Srikanth, Kishore, Riyan Joe Jerry, Raj Ayyappa, Siddharth Babu and Namritha MV.It premiered on JioHotstar on 27 May 2026.
plot:
The Ponmalar household, led by the strict textile businessman Shanmuga Sundaram "SS" and his warm-hearted wife Ponmalar, appears happy and tightly knit on the surface. They have four children with distinct personalities: Jayshree (a lawyer), Harini(an IT employee), Jagadeesh "Jaggu" (a DJ), and Meera (an aspiring cricketer).
Their peaceful routines are upended when a shocking revelation emerges: their father has a hidden affair. United by their love for their mother and a desire to protect their family, the siblings band together, taking an oath to expose the affair and shield their family from breaking apart.
reception: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "On a hot, summer day with overwhelming viewing options, Brothers and Sisters is a safe, convenient choice, tailored for family-friendly viewing. The story is minimal, the atmosphere is light, it deals with relatable characters in a few stock situations and has its target audience entertained without trying too hard".Sree of OTT Release wrote that, "Not a “perfect binge,” but definitely an emotionally messy, sometimes slow, sometimes powerful family drama. If you like stories that feel more real than refined, this one might stick with you longer than expected".

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
In April 2026, JioHotstar announced Brothers and Sisters, a Tamil family drama web series created and directed by Chidambaram Manivannan. The series was developed as a spiritual successor to Uppu Puli Kaaram (2024), with Manivannan returning to explore themes of family relationships, sibling bonds and everyday domestic life through a new story and set of characters and positioning it as a continuation of the long-format family storytelling style popularized by the earlier series.The technical crew included music director Saran Raghavan, cinematographer Manikandan Ramamoorthy and art director Vasu Dhevan.
The series is directed by Chidambaram Manivannan and written by A. C. Karnamurthy. It is produced by Vikatan Televistas, a production company known for producing Tamil television serials such as Siragadikka Aasai, Thamizhum Saraswathiyum and Uppu Puli Kaaram.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The series stars Bose Venkat and Gayathri Shastry were cast in the lead roles, alongside Raj Ayyappa, Nikhila Sankar, Luthuf, Kishore, Shravnitha Srikanth, Siddharth Babu, Pramodini Pammi and Namritha MV.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The first trailer was released on 25 April 2026, featuring the Ponmalar family as they navigate personal conflicts and unexpected challenges arising from a long-buried family secret.
It was announced that the series would be released in Tamil and other Indian languages and made its streaming debut on 27 May 2026.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "On a hot, summer day with overwhelming viewing options, Brothers and Sisters is a safe, convenient choice, tailored for family-friendly viewing. The story is minimal, the atmosphere is light, it deals with relatable characters in a few stock situations and has its target audience entertained without trying too hard".Sree of OTT Release wrote that, "Not a “perfect binge,” but definitely an emotionally messy, sometimes slow, sometimes powerful family drama. If you like stories that feel more real than refined, this one might stick with you longer than expected".

episodesList.title: The House of SS
episodesList.summary: Meet the family of SS and his devoted wife, along with their beautiful children. In Bengaluru, their first daughter Jayshree's live-in boyfriend goes missing.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Second Chance
episodesList.summary: Priyan saves Jayshree after her drastic decision. SS and his family are unable to contact her. Meanwhile, Siddharth opens up to his mother about his feelings for Harini.

episodesList.title: Priyan Guides Jayshree
episodesList.summary: As Jayshree struggles to cope, Priyan makes her face reality and persuades her to return to the warmth of her family. Back at home, Meera gives SS a makeover.

episodesList.title: Harini vs Jayshree's Secret
episodesList.summary: Jayshree returns home and manages to hide her secret. However, Harini begins to sense that something is wrong and suspects that she is hiding a problem.

episodesList.title: Harini Stands by Jayshree
episodesList.summary: SS rejects Ponmalar's brother Azhagar's marriage proposal for Jayshree. Meanwhile, Harini takes Jayshree for counseling to help her feel better.

episodesList.title: Harini Meets Siddharth's Mother
episodesList.summary: SS gets the jewels from Ponmalar to secure funds for Girija's investment in a new house. Meanwhile, Siddharth's mother pays a visit to his office to meet his love interest, Harini.

episodesList.title: New Opportunity for Jayshree
episodesList.summary: When Harini looks for a lawyer's job for Jayshree, Siddharth uses his connections and helps her get a job. His father is surprised and questions him about his unusual behaviour.

episodesList.title: Jaggu and Madhu Grow Closer
episodesList.summary: Jaggu and Madhu find themselves growing closer as new feelings spark between them. Meanwhile, Girija celebrates a fresh start by hosting a grand house-warming function.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Faces Roshini's Love
episodesList.summary: Despite Girija's objections, Madhu visits jail to meet someone. Following his mother's advice, Siddharth asks Roshini to move out of his cabin. But Roshini has different plans.

episodesList.title: Harini Opens Up
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gives Meera a hard time about her siblings' attitude towards him. Meanwhile, Harini shares her budding love interest with Jayshree.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Jayshree unexpectedly meets Priyan and learns of his situation. On the marriage front, things move too fast for Jayshree, but Harini convinces her to agree for now.

episodesList.title: Jaggu's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Girija asks SS to accompany her to a friend's wedding. At Jaggu's DJ gig, he sees something that shakes his world.

episodesList.title: SS's Secret Shocks the Family
episodesList.summary: Jaggu discovers a startling truth about SS and confides in his sisters. Together, they decide to keep their mother unaware of the situation.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Presents the Proof
episodesList.summary: As his sisters struggle to accept it, Jaggu presents proof of SS's affair. Unaware of the growing tension, SS remains busy preparing for the groom's visit to see Jayshree.

episodesList.title: Humiliation Strikes Jayshree
episodesList.summary: When the groom publicly reveals the truth about Jayshree, Ponmalar collapses from the shock. While Jaggu watches helplessly, Priyan steps in to comfort a devastated Jayshree.

episodesList.title: SS Realises His Love for Ponmalar
episodesList.summary: After regaining consciousness, Ponmalar asks for Jayshree. Watching SS care for Ponmalar, Jaggu and his sisters begin to realise the depth of his feelings for her.

episodesList.title: Jaggu's Outburst
episodesList.summary: Jaggu comes home drunk and has a heated argument with his sisters. He accuses Jayshree of being responsible for their mother's condition, leaving her feeling hurt.

episodesList.title: A Home Filled with Care
episodesList.summary: As Ponmalar gets discharged from the hospital, the girls take charge of the cooking and other chores. Ponmalar talks to SS about getting Jayshree married to her brother, Keerthi.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Fixes Jayshree's Alliance
episodesList.summary: Madhu feels Jaggu is distancing himself from her. Meanwhile, Jayshree is unable to voice her feelings after Ponmalar convinces her brother and finalises her alliance with Keerthi.

episodesList.title: SS Under Scrutiny
episodesList.summary: Girija takes SS to an Ayurvedic clinic for Ponmalar’s medicines. While Ponmalar is happy with his care and concern, Jaggu questions him about his mysterious hospital visit.

episodesList.title: Harini Says No
episodesList.summary: SS agrees to a marriage between Jayshree and Ponmalar's brother, Keerthi. During a car ride, Siddharth insists on taking Harini out for a lunch date, much to Harini's displeasure.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Learns About Madhu's Family
episodesList.summary: Jayshree meets Priyan and tells him about her marriage alliance with her relative and her decision to reveal her secrets. Meanwhile, Jaggu meets Madhu and digs into her family.

episodesList.title: The Children Plot Against SS
episodesList.summary: SS asks Ponmalar to accompany him to secure a loan for the shop. However, Jaggu and his sisters decide to stop them.

episodesList.title: Jayshree Tells the Truth
episodesList.summary: SS vents his frustration to Girija about the business loan issue. When Ponmalar's relatives arrive to finalise the wedding, Jayshree decides to reveal the truth to Keerthi.

episodesList.title: SS Chooses Girija
episodesList.summary: After Keerthy rejects the marriage, SS and Jayshree hide it from Ponmalar. SS plans a trip to Ahmedabad to procure stock for Ponmalar Textiles and asks Girija to accompany him.

episodesList.title: Madhu Convinces Girija!
episodesList.summary: Madhu encourages Girija not to accompany SS on the Ahmedabad trip, accusing the latter of being selfish. Meanwhile, Jaggu strikes up a new friendship with Meena.

episodesList.title: SS's Silent Hurt
episodesList.summary: Jayshree and her sisters plan to reunite their parents by making Ponmalar sleep in their father's room. SS is deeply hurt when they question his business decisions.

episodesList.title: A Twist on Madhu's Birthday
episodesList.summary: After Girija leaves for Ahmedabad with SS, Madhu is left alone on her birthday. She invites Jaggu to her house and feeling sorry for her, he visits her. But a surprise awaits him.

episodesList.title: Meera's Smart Move
episodesList.summary: As SS leaves for Ahmedabad with Girija, Jaggu and the sisters try to disrupt their trip. Meera’s smart move of joining Ponmalar Textiles surprises everyone.

episodesList.title: Harini's Unexpected Demand
episodesList.summary: Harini agrees to accept Siddharth's love with a shocking condition, leaving him torn. Meanwhile, Ponmalar discovers why Keerthi rejected the wedding proposal.

episodesList.title: SS Under Meera's Watch
episodesList.summary: After the family's pleas, SS lets Meera intern at Ponmalar textiles. However, rather than concentrating on her training, Meera remains highly observant of SS's every action.

episodesList.title: Girija Seeks SS's Support
episodesList.summary: Girija opposes Madhu's love interest, leading to a rift between them. She hopes for support from SS. A heated argument between Priyan and Jayshree unexpectedly brings them closer.

episodesList.title: SS Lies to Ponmalar
episodesList.summary: Madhu's hospitalisation forces SS to rush to her and her mother, but Ponmalar has questions. Meanwhile, Siddharth goes to Girija's apartment building in search of a new house.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Alarms Harini with Truth
episodesList.summary: Siddharth agrees to Harini's request to live near Girija's house and reveals that he knows the truth. Girija catches Madhu on a call with Jaggu and questions her.

episodesList.title: Jayshree, Priyan's Special Moment
episodesList.summary: SS rages at Girija for visiting his shop when his daughter is present. Jayshree helps Priyan admit his pregnant sister to the hospital and they share a heartfelt moment together.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Takes Harini Home
episodesList.summary: Priyan is deeply touched as Jayshree gets nutritious postnatal meal for his sister at the hospital. Siddharth introduces Harini to his mother. Velpandi spots them and gets upset.

episodesList.title: Madhu's Love Confession
episodesList.summary: Madhu bares her heart to Jaggu, but his unexpected response leaves her shattered. Meanwhile, Siddharth performs his house-warming ceremony and meets Girija.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Fumble
episodesList.summary: Siddharth plays the good neighbour to Girija when she is away from home. Ponmalar again coaxes Jayshree to consider marrying. To pacify her, Jayshree blurts out a lie.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan
episodesList.summary: SS resists the auditor's pressure to sell his textile business as Jaggu seeks a solution. At the hospital, Ponmalar runs into Priyan and mistakes his and Jayshree's bond for love.

episodesList.title: SS Draws the Line
episodesList.summary: As Thangam and her sons take charge of SS's security, SS asks Jaggu to end the arrangement. When SS confides in Girija, she advises him to sell Ponmalar Textiles.

episodesList.title: Madhu's Heartfelt Confession
episodesList.summary: As SS struggles with a crisis at Ponmalar Textiles, Jayshree offers legal help. Elsewhere, Madhu makes an emotional confession to Jaggu and questions why he cannot love her back.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan's Family
episodesList.summary: Ponmalar decides to visit Priyan and his family to check on them, leaving Jayshree in shock. Meanwhile, Girija changes Madhu's mind and begins searching for a groom for her.

episodesList.title: SS Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: SS mysteriously goes missing, throwing Girija's household into chaos when the groom's family arrives. Ponmalar and her daughters desperately search for SS, fearing for his safety.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Seeks Thangam's Help
episodesList.summary: Jaggu approaches Meenu and asks for Thangam's help in finding his missing father. Meanwhile, Harini asks Siddharth to seek his father's assistance in moving the case forward.

episodesList.title: Girija Avoids SS
episodesList.summary: SS returns home after going missing for a night. Girija is angry with SS and refuses to answer his calls. As the stress builds, she faints, and Siddharth helps her.

episodesList.title: SS Faces Girija's Wrath
episodesList.summary: SS worries about Girija avoiding his calls and goes to her house. Once there, she vents her frustration and disappointment.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Talks About Priyan
episodesList.summary: Madhu and Girija plan to rent out their house without SS's involvement. Ponmalar has a conversation with Jayshree about Priyan.

episodesList.title: Priyan Plays Reluctant Cupid
episodesList.summary: Baskar approaches Jayshree using Priyan's phone, creating friction between Jayshree and Priyan. Girija realises SS was indeed kidnapped.

title: Memu Copulam
summary: Memu Copulam (stylized as Memu COP'ulam; transl. We are Cops) is an Indian Telugu-language comedy-mystery streaming television series scheduled to premiere on 22 May 2026. The series is directed by Pradeep Maddali, written by Shoban Chittuprolu, and produced by B. V. S. Ravi and Kaumudi K. Nemani under the RAW Entertainments production banner. The series features Nagendra Babu, Getup Srinu, and Ravi Teja Nannimala in the principal roles.
plot:
Set against a rural backdrop in the Godavari districts during the Sankranti festival, the narrative focuses on Mahadevapatnam, a village noted for its competitive cockfighting culture. Gajapathi Raju (Nagendra Babu), a prominent local chief, owns a highly prized fighting rooster named "Salaar Raju". Shortly before a major tournament, the rooster disappears under mysterious circumstances.
The investigation is assigned to Ravi Sotari (Ravi Teja Nannimala) and Mohan Sotari (Getup Srinu), two inexperienced and bumbling police constables. While pursuing eccentric clues and mismanaging the investigation, the officers inadvertently uncover a broader underlying conspiracy that impacts the village community.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Following the release of the series Vikkatakavi, director Pradeep Maddali collaborated with production banner RAW Entertainments for an investigative comedy series titled Memu Copulam. The script was developed by Shoban Chittuprolu, focusing on regional rural satire and situational comedy.

articleSections.title: Title controversy and marketing
articleSections.text:
In early May 2026, the producers initiated a marketing campaign involving a staged conflict. A video clip emerged online showing actor Getup Srinu and television journalist Jaffar engaged in a heated argument during a mock interview. In the footage, Jaffar criticized the project's title, misinterpreting it as "Memu Kapulam" (), and questioned the integration of caste-based identities in regional cinema. Getup Srinu simulated walking out of the interview, which led to widespread discussion and polarization among social media users.
The production team subsequently clarified that the altercation was a planned promotional stunt. They revealed that the actual title was stylized as Memu COP'ulam, a pun substituting the Telugu word Kapulam (guardians/caste reference) with the English word Cop (police officers) to reflect the protagonists' occupations. The official trailer for the series was launched on 14 May 2026 by Telugu actor Brahmanandam.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Memu Copulam is scheduled to stream on the digital platform ZEE5 beginning 22 May 2026.

Set against a rural backdrop in the Godavari districts during the Sankranti festival, the narrative focuses on Mahadevapatnam, a village noted for its competitive cockfighting culture. Gajapathi Raju (Nagendra Babu), a prominent local chief, owns a highly prized fighting rooster named "Salaar Raju". Shortly before a major tournament, the rooster disappears under mysterious circumstances.
The investigation is assigned to Ravi Sotari (Ravi Teja Nannimala) and Mohan Sotari (Getup Srinu), two inexperienced and bumbling police constables. While pursuing eccentric clues and mismanaging the investigation, the officers inadvertently uncover a broader underlying conspiracy that impacts the village community.
tagline: In a village obsessed with cockfighting, two bumbling constables stumble upon a conspiracy after a prized rooster goes missing during the Sankranti festival.

title: Warrant: From the World of Vilangu
wikiTitle: Warrant: From the World of Vilangu
summary:
Warrant: From the World of Vilangu is an Indian Tamil-language procedural crime thriller streaming television series written and created by Prasanth Pandiyaraj and directed by Vignesh Natarajan. The series is a spin-off and thematic extension of the 2022 streaming series Vilangu.
The series stars creator Prasanth Pandiyaraj in his on-screen acting debut, alongside an ensemble cast including Balaji Sakthivel, Kaali Venkat, Aruldoss, and Namritha MV. It released on 22 May 2026.
plot: Set within the same fictional universe as Vilangu, the series explores the procedural aspects of legal warrants, institutional pressure, and ethical conflicts within a local police department. The narrative follows Koattai Karuppasamy, a timid police constable subjected to institutional bullying and workplace humiliation. The plot details his subsequent behavioral shift while handling a sudden death in police custody, forcing a conflict between systemic compliance and personal conscience.
reception: Warrant received mixed-to-positive reviews, with critics praising the realistic atmosphere and lead performance while highlighting inconsistent pacing. The Times of India lauded the final episodes and Grimy authenticity, whereas The New Indian Express criticized the show for normalizing police misconduct.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Following the viewership response to Vilangu in 2022, creator Prasanth Pandiyaraj began developing an extension of the franchise. According to Pandiyaraj, the concept for Warrant was conceptualized during the writing phase of the original series, drawing from research and interviews conducted with real-world law enforcement personnel. While Pandiyaraj retained creative oversight as the series showrunner, directional duties were allocated to Vignesh Natarajan, who had previously served as a co-director on Vilangu.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Vemal was cast to return to anchor the investigative narrative continuity. Showrunner Prasanth Pandiyaraj was cast in the co-lead role of the series after director Vignesh Natarajan suggested him during pre-production due to time constraints and the production's requirement for an actor unfamiliar to the audience.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The official trailer for the series was released on May 9, 2026. All episodes released on ZEE5 on May 22, 2026.

title: Palayathu Amman
summary:
Palayathu Amman is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language Devotional drama television series written and directed by Mangai Harirajan. Starring Sanghavi, Kamalesh PK and Haripriya Isai, it follows a challenges faced by Abirami, a childless woman who has been married for many years, and many mysterious things happening around her.
The show was produced by H. Priyatharshni under Naren Vision banner. It premiered on Jaya TV on 18 May 2026, and airs from Monday to Thursday at 20:00. It was also shown on Jaya TV and Vision Time Tamil's YouTube channel after it originally aired.
This is the first original series to air on Jaya TV after 10 years.

Ramesh, the editing by Uma Shankar Babu, Selvin, Muthu, and the music by S.P. Poopathy.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Actress Sanghavi was cast in the female role Abirami, making her comeback to acting in Tamil serials after 8 years. It is the third collaboration with Jaya TV after Savithri and Kalabhairava, which aired from 2013. Sanghavi has worked with Mangai Harirajan’s series Thai Veedu which had an aired on Vendhar TV 2017 to 2018.
Kamalesh PK played the role of Abirami's husband, Haripriya Isai played the important role. The series also reunited Kamalesh PK and Haripriya Isai, who previously starred together in the Sun TV’s serial Ethirneechal. Actors Anu Mohan, C. Ranganathan and Yaar Kannan are playing supporting roles.

title: Hathras – 16 Days
summary: Hathras – 16 Days is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language documentary television series directed by Patrick Graham and produced by Tanushree Pandey, an investigative journalist and documentary filmmaker known for her reporting on human rights, conflict, and social justice issues released on 15 May 2026.  The series is based on the 2020 Hathras case in Uttar Pradesh..
plot: Set over a period of 16 days, the series covers the investigation into the Hathras case and the reactions that followed across Uttar Pradesh and the national media. It also looks at the role played by journalists, local officials and the victim's family during the controversy.
reception:
The series received mixed reviews from critics.
A review by The Times of India gave the series 3 out of 5 stars, stating "While the series does uncover the many layers of caste, gender, authority, and narrative control, one only wishes it had a more layered execution — one that went deeper into the lives and emotions of the people most impacted by this horrific crime".
M9 News described the series as a difficult but important watch and highlighted its focus on the victim's family and the wider public response to the case.

title: Vimal Khanna
summary: Vimal Khanna is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller television series adapted from Vimal series by author Surender Mohan Pathak. It is directed by Abhhinav Pareek and written by Uddeept Dutt Gaur for Amazon MX Player. It stars Sunny Hinduja in the titular role alongside Isha Talwar.
reception: Abhishek Srivastava of The Times of India gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "‘Vimal Khanna’ Season One settles into being an average but watchable thriller because it often chooses surface-level storytelling over layered elements. It delivers enough suspense and a dependable central performance to satisfy viewers looking for an uncomplicated crime drama, though it rarely aims higher than that."

title: Exam
summary:
Exam is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language Crime thriller streaming television series created by Pushkar–Gayathri for Amazon Prime Video written and directed  by A. Sarkunam. The show is about a young woman who carries a mysterious past and focuses on ambition, morality, and the consequences of systemic injustice.
The principal cast of the series includes Dushara Vijayan, Aditi Balan, Abbas and Akash Venkatesan. It premiered on 15 May 2026 and consists of seven episodes.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series is Pushkar–Gayathri`s third collaboration with Amazon Prime Video, after Suzhal: The Vortex (2022–2025) and Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie (2022). The series is directed by National Film Awards winner A. Sarkunam, making his debut in a limited series.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Actresses, Dushara Vijayan and Aditi Balan was cast as police officer Jhansi and Maramalli. Tamil film actor Abbas cast as Jayachandran. This is his debut role in a limited series.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Amazon Prime Video released the series' first teaser on 19 March 2026. On 30 April, it was released in a trailer and revealed the release date. Exam premiered on the platform two weeks later, on 15 May and the series will be released in Tamil and dubbed in Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada languages.

episodesList.title: Two-Headed Serpent
episodesList.summary: Based on his excellent academic record, a poor fisherwoman dreams of her son becoming a government officer one day. DSP Maramalli is transferred to Thykara police station a week ahead of the highly competitive RPSE exams. Jhansi pulls off a high-risk stunt, leaving Maramalli helpless. A nervous Jhansi takes over as DSP. Can Jhansi's deception hold against the truth?

episodesList.title: The Path to the Unknown Destiny
episodesList.summary: Reeling from the loss of his mother, the fisherwoman's son becomes disillusioned after a wealthy woman reveals how her son became a coveted government officer. In Thykara, Jhansi, guided by her mentor Jayachandran, starts investigating RPSE training institutions. Maramalli continues to fight a silent battle. Jhansi's mask is at risk when uninvited guests show up at the police station.

episodesList.title: The Faceless Shadow
episodesList.summary: With his hopes crushed, yet his mind sharp as ever, the fisherwoman's son seeks Shanti Amma's help to land a new job. Jhansi convinces Maramalli's mother that Maramalli is on a covert undercover operation and must not be disturbed. Jhansi resorts to aggression to further unearth the scam. Maramalli gets crafty and makes a smart attempt to escape. Is it the endgame for Jhansi's deception?

episodesList.title: The Strangled Voice
episodesList.summary: The fisherwoman's son's life pivots as he takes up his new job near an RPSE Coaching Institute. Young Jhansi and Young Maramalli take up their RPSE exams, oblivious to what the future holds. Young Jhansi's life is thrown into a downward spiral. Jailer Jayachandran takes Jhansi under his wings.

episodesList.title: Come Forth, O Sword-Bearer
episodesList.summary: The fisherwoman's son's ambition puts him at odds with a powerful man, and he begins to forge his own path. Jayachandran actively pursues a lead in investigating the suspicious suicide at an RPSE training institute. Jhansi uses yet another trick to close in on the scammers, and is stunned by the involvement of an unanticipated person. A phone call leaves Jhansi shattered.

episodesList.title: The Fury of the Red Tea
episodesList.summary: Kumaresan's hidden past comes to light, revealing powerful connections. Believing they have finally figured out the scam, Jhansi's team sets an elaborate trap for the masterminds. But as they focus on their target, the real threat emerges from an unexpected corner. Jhansi and Maramalli are forced into a reluctant alliance to fight their way out.

episodesList.title: The Fish That Hunted for the Duck
episodesList.summary: On the day of the RPSE exam, Jhansi discovers that she has been outplayed by Kumaresan's cunning plan. The walls close in on her from all sides, and she is left to fight for survival. Kumaresan's past deeds catch up with him, revealing a darker shade of the scam. Is justice finally served to Jhansi, or is she doomed forever?

title: Glory
summary:
Glory is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language sports thriller television series written and directed by Karan Anshuman and Kanishk Varma for Netflix. The series is produced by Karan Anshuman and Mohit Shah of Atomic Films. It stars Divyenndu, Pulkit Samrat and Suvinder Vicky as pivotal role.
The series was filmed mostly across Haryana. John Schmidt served as the cinematographer of the series. John Stewart Eduri composed the background score. 
The first season of Glory was released on 1 May 2026.
plot: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.
reception:
Anuj Kumar for The Hindu stated the series "a cohesive whole for viewers attuned to logical consistency and tonal balance."
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and raised concern about violence shown stating "Animals aren’t spared either."
Joel Keller of Decider stated the series as "it’s a pretty dark and violent story." Bhavna Agarwal of India Today wrote "The idea is strong: use a whodunit to peel back emotional layers. And initially, it works."
Suchin Mehrotra of The Hollywood Reporter India stated "shamelessly pulpy crime drama in recent memory — emotionally potent, generically promiscuous, and rich with festering old wounds." Udita Jhunjhunwala for Scroll.in felt the violence is extreme." BH Harsh of Cinema Express praised Divyenndu's performance and wrote "Divyenndu delivers a stellar performance."
Abhimanyu Mathur Hindustan Times stated "Glory is a good example of ‘what could have been’, which has been the story of Indian OTT since the pandemic." Bollywood Hungama rated the series 3 stars in their review.
Shachi Chaturvedi from News18 stated "the narrative could have benefited from tighter storytelling."
