title: Local Times
summary:
Local Times is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language workplace comedy-drama streaming television series created by Abbhinav Kastura and Praveen Muthurangan for Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Naveen George Thomas in his directorial debut, the series stars Rishikanth, Abdool Lee, Adwitha Arumugam, Maurish Dass, R. Pandiarajan, and Chinni Jayanth.
The series centers on a struggling local newspaper and follows four friends managing the publication.
plot:
The story revolves around Namma Seidhi, a once-respected regional weekly newspaper founded by the grandfather of Veera. In a landscape dominated by instant digital media and social media trends, the publication is on the verge of financial collapse, surviving primarily on the hope and grit of its small team.
Veera, driven by a sense of legacy, works alongside his best friend Azhagu, the resourceful Valli, and a dedicated intern, Muthu. Rather than hard-hitting investigative journalism, the team's daily routine often involves the more mundane struggles of news-gathering, securing local advertisements, managing mounting debts, and navigating petty office politics.
reception:
The series received generally positive reviews, with critics describing it as a light-hearted and feel-good watch. The Times of India noted that while the script relied on "contrived writing," the performances and "core friendship" made it an engaging "time-pass" watch.
Writing for The Hollywood Reporter India, Vishal Menon characterized the show as "basic background viewing pleasure," citing the relatable setting and likeable characters.
Scroll.in found the show's focus was on character-driven humor rather than the mechanics of journalism, remarking that "low on news-gathering and high on joke-gathering."
Cinema Express gave a negative review in which M Narayani stated ..."the screenplay starts to shred apart due to the lack of a novel premise. The comedy sequences too offer no respite from the drab scenes, and every time a character tries to break into a joke or two, the results lie somewhere in between eye-roll-inducing and something as old as the 2000s"

episodesList.title: Avargal
episodesList.summary: A proof-of-life photo from a local kidnapping features their newspaper, pulling the gang into the case. Covertly helping the police to crack it- in the process, they accidentally land their first big headline.

episodesList.title: Indru Poi Naalai Vaa
episodesList.summary: A payment blunder bruises the ego of a local boxer, prompting a one-on-one challenge. Just as the gang scrambles for a champion amongst themselves, the kidnapper from previous episode returns, setting the stage for a chaotic showdown as multiple gangs converge on their office, all focused to destroy them.

episodesList.title: Aan Paavam
episodesList.summary: A 40-year-old woman shocks the gang by requesting an ad in their newspaper putting herself up for adoption after being abandoned by her children. A new interested party pressures them to sell their newspaper, sparking a rift between Veera and Azhagu.

episodesList.title: Iruvar
episodesList.summary: After an intense fight, Azhagu quits Namma Seidhi, leaving the gang in shock. While dealing with the fallout, a vlogger drags the newspaper into an expose, accusing it of promoting low-quality restaurants and calling it a scam. Will Veera and Azhagu bury the hatchet to save the paper, or is this the end of Namma Seidhi?

episodesList.title: Nizhal Nijamaagiradhu
episodesList.summary: An anonymous source approaches the gang with news before it happens. Initially wary, they decide to publish his stories, and after missing the first-which proves true-the second one boosts their PR. As trust in the source grows, could this partnership save their sinking newspaper, or his good deeds too good to be true?

episodesList.title: Naalaya Seidhi
episodesList.summary: After a major story from the new source backfires, nearly driving away all their advertisers, the gang discovers the identity of the puppet master behind the chaos. He has a clear agenda: to buy Namma Seidhi as cheaply as possible by playing as dirty as possible.

episodesList.title: Makkal Aatchi
episodesList.summary: The gang makes the biggest blunder in the history of Newsprint -printing empty pages that reach the community. But a stroke of luck turns the mistake into a symbol of protest. Will they survive the fallout, or is this truly the end of Namma Seidhi?

title: Resort
summary:
Resort is an Indian Tamil-language culinary workplace comedy sitcom television series starring Vijay Kumar Rajendran, Abeneya Nethrun and Thalaivasal Vijay. The series is written by Vijay Kumar Rajendran and directed by Praveen Bennett for JioHotstar. The plot revolves follows Vetri, a 12th-fail room service boy with exceptional culinary talent and dreams of becoming a chef.
The principal characters of the series include Elango Kumanan , Dharshna Sripal Golecha, Ebi Rajhn, Kavipriya Jayavel, Keerthivel, Amar Keerthi, Vishnu Bala, Sai Dhanyaa, Badava Gopi,  Giri Dwarakish and Lallu.It premiered on JioHotstar on 13 March 2026.
plot: Set in the fictional RR Resort, the story centers on Vetri, a 12th-fail room service worker who dreams of becoming a professional chef. Despite possessing natural culinary talent, he faces constant humiliation and pressure from a ruthless kitchen hierarchy. Determined to prove himself, Vetri begins challenging the toxic system, navigating friendships, rivalry, and ambition in a high-stakes hospitality environment.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by JioHotstar on 9 December 2025 as part of its South UnBound content slate. The platform planned to launch nine new Tamil-language original shows under the initiative. Resort was developed as one of the projects in this lineup and was created as one of the Hotstar Specials series scheduled for release in 2026.
The series is directed by Praveen Bennett and written by Vijay Kumar Rajendran. It is produced by Global Villagers, a production company known for producing Tamil television serials such as Mahanadhi, Ayyanar Thunai and Kana Kaanum Kaalangal.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The official glimpse of the series was released on 9 December 2025 by JioHotstar ahead of the series’ premiere, introducing the setting of a luxury resort and the central characters while highlighting the show’s blend of workplace drama and comedy.The first trailer was released on 2 March 2026, featuring Vetri joining the RR Resort as a housekeeping employee while aspiring to become a professional chef, as he faces the strict supervision of executive chef Nedumaaran, highlighting the series’ blend of workplace comedy, ambition, and drama.
It was announced that the series would be released in Tamil and other Indian languages and made its streaming debut on 13 March 2026.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "The four episodes of Resort precisely set the ground ready for the drama to marinate over the coming weeks. There is nothing overwhelmingly new about the story, clash and the drama, yet it is perfectly suited for timepass, inoffensive viewing, a bare minimum that we do not get to experience lately".

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: At the middle of April 2026, Malayalam actress Anugraha S Nambiar, who plays the role of Srinidhi, released a video alleging that the makers of his web series Resort Producer and actor Vijay Kumar Rajendran and his wife have not paid her fee and have engaged in contractual traps.

episodesList.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodesList.title: Unwitting Actions
episodesList.summary: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodesList.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodesList.summary: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodesList.title: Doomed
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodesList.title: Be Irreplaceable
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodesList.title: Behind the Mask
episodesList.summary: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

episodesList.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodesList.summary: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodesList.title: Ghost from the Past
episodesList.summary: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodesList.title: Frozen in Fear
episodesList.summary: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodesList.title: Gearing Up
episodesList.summary: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodesList.summary: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodesList.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodesList.summary: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodesList.title: Fresh Ally
episodesList.summary: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodesList.title: Comeuppance
episodesList.summary: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodesList.title: Covetous Desire
episodesList.summary: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodesList.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodesList.title: Emotional Armour
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

episodesList.title: Seething Anger
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

episodesList.title: Face from the Past
episodesList.summary: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

episodesList.title: Close Confidante
episodesList.summary: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

episodesList.title: Secret Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

episodesList.title: Drifting Apart
episodesList.summary: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

episodesList.title: Where is Chika?
episodesList.summary: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

episodesList.title: Lovelorn Veni
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

episodesList.title: Delving into the Past
episodesList.summary: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

episodesList.title: The Supercilious Chef
episodesList.summary: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

episodesList.title: Resurfacing of Memories
episodesList.summary: Aishu takes Vetri's mom and sister to her house for a day and is shocked to see Nedumaran back early from his travel. What happens when he learns the truth about their background?

episodesList.title: New Ideas
episodesList.summary: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

episodesList.title: Dinner or Date?
episodesList.summary: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

episodesList.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

episodesList.title: The Clock Is Ticking
episodesList.summary: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

episodesList.title: The Shindig
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

episodesList.title: The Apologetic Attacker
episodesList.summary: John tries to target Vetri to appease Nedumaran by messing up a guest's order. Vicky attends his friend's bachelor party and finds Vetri taking their 'special' food order.

episodesList.title: Native Charm
episodesList.summary: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

episodesList.title: Busted
episodesList.summary: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

episodesList.title: Smoking Gun
episodesList.summary: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

episodesList.title: Disillusioned
episodesList.summary: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

episodesList.title: Penitent Vetri
episodesList.summary: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

episodesList.title: Stonewalling
episodesList.summary: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

episodesList.title: Dissolved in Tears
episodesList.summary: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

episodesList.title: Mea Culpa
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

episodesList.title: Food Fest'26
episodesList.summary: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

episodesList.title: Languishing in Prison!
episodesList.summary: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

episodesList.title: Flopped Business
episodesList.summary: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

episodesList.title: Nudging Friends
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

episodesList.title: Renewed Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

episodesList.title: Renaissance
episodesList.summary: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

episodesList.title: Filial Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

episodesList.title: Immolating Dreams
episodesList.summary: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

episodesList.title: Culinary Stage
episodesList.summary: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

episodesList.title: Entrapped
episodesList.summary: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

episodesList.title: Frantic Search
episodesList.summary: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

episodesList.title: A Daughter's Atonement
episodesList.summary: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

episodesList.title: Contrasting Sisters
episodesList.summary: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

episodesList.title: Bitter Encounters
episodesList.summary: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

episodesList.title: Aishu's Complaint
episodesList.summary: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

episodesList.title: Suspicions Sparked
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

episodesList.title: Yearning Daughters
episodesList.summary: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

episodesList.title: Booming Pantry Sales
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

episodesList.title: Showered by Appreciation
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

episodesList.title: Spurned Invitation
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran lashes at Divya for inviting him to her wedding. John announces the Star Chef competition. Priya plans her revenge by tarnishing Nedumaran's name at Divya's wedding.

episodesList.title: Wrecking the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran's new signature dish becomes an instant hit. He ignores Karthik who tries to convince him to attend the wedding. Priya executes her plan amidst the wedding preparations.

episodesList.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
episodesList.summary: Priya's plan fails as Nedumaran handles the situation. Divya is elated to see her father at her wedding as Aishu gives him an earful. Nedumaran rages when Aishu shows him a photo.

episodesList.title: A Bride's Farewell
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran has a private word with Karthik before bidding the newlyweds goodbye. Uthaman introduces the new members to the room service team. Meanwhile, Vetri falls sick.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: When Vicky and Veni share a private moment, Nedumaran conducts an inspection, alarming Vetri. Aishu asks about the untoward kitchen incidents and the picture from Nedumaran's desk.

episodesList.title: Ravaged Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Riya finds out the reason behind Deepak's return and confronts him. Ragupathi asks everyone to prepare for a minister's visit, but Priya has another plan up her sleeve.

episodesList.title: Against All Odds
episodesList.summary: The kitchen's destruction upsets the chefs. Nedumaran proposes that his team move into the pantry temporarily, but Riya opposes it vehemently. What will Ragupathi decide?

episodesList.title: Rajan's Avowal
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is angry by the minister’s mother’s words. While Riya assures her dad she is happy, Rajan admits to Aishu that he loves Riya. Vetri helps Aishu with a last-minute order.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Notoriety
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is shocked to see a viral video stating the fire in the kitchen was due to his neglect, but Veni has doubts. He fumes as the minister and his family enjoy pantry food.

episodesList.title: Minister's Misattribution
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi is moved by Aishu’s suggestion to get Riya and Rajan married. Priya celebrates with her brother. The minister applauds Nedumaran for the amazing dishes in the pantry.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Unpleasant Encounter
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is upset by a call and the profit margin between the kitchen and pantry. Veni learns that Priya is constantly following Nedumaran. Martin visits Nedumaran at RR resort.

episodesList.title: All about Chika
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran meets Chidambaram aka Chika, who wins hearts with his cooking. Ragupathi nominates him for a Star Chef competition. Upset, Nedumaran decides to cook for a hunting party.

episodesList.title: Web of Deceptions
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran reports illegal hunting and leaves Chika alone in the forest. Chika gets arrested. At the resort, Nedumaran spins a tale about Chika’s missing, all for a Star Chef award.

episodesList.title: Hidden Feelings
episodesList.summary: Vetri is heartbroken to see Aishu’s ex-boyfriend. A complaint about a pantry dish has Nedumaran fuming. Rajan admits his feelings to Riya. Vetri is thrilled as Aishu lifts the ban.

episodesList.title: Old Flame
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran complains to Ragupathi about the pantry. Aishu and Selvin catch up after ages. Veni spies on Priya. Ramya confides in Aishu about Vetri while Ragupathi collapses in pain.

episodesList.title: Stricken Ragupathi
episodesList.summary: Priya becomes cautious when Veni and Vetri visit her house. Ragupathi is hospitalised and Nedumaran assumes that he will be taking over the resort in his absence.

episodesList.title: Who is the Alpha?
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran stops Rajan's staff meeting and lets everyone know who the boss is. Aishu is selected for the Star Chef event. Vetri is shocked as Nedumaran replaces the pantry staff.

episodesList.title: Rebuffed
episodesList.summary: Veni scolds Vicky for being rude to Vetri. Nedumaran insults Vetri for questioning about the pantry. Ragupathi tells Rajan to take charge of the resort. Ramya proposes to Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Next CEO!
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran takes complete control of the resort, and everyone worries as word spreads that he'll be the next CEO. Ragupathi recovers and immediately calls for an investor's meeting.

episodesList.title: Bittersweet Departure
episodesList.summary: RR Resort is in chaos after Nedumaran walks out with his team. Rajan handles the situation calmly. Aishu bids farewell to Vetri. Nedumaran leaves the Kitchen with bitter emotion.

episodesList.title: Seizing the Day
episodesList.summary: Vicky exploits the situation at the resort. Vetri asks Riya to help him join the Kitchen team. While admitted in the hospital, Vetri’s mother reveals the truth about his father.

episodesList.title: Strengthening Ties
episodesList.summary: Rajan confidently meets the resort's investors and explains his future plans. Since Vicky struggles to run the Kitchen with reduced staff, Riya and Rajan offer him a solution.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Minion
episodesList.summary: Vetri asks for help from Veni and others for the Star Chef competition and goes in search of a former winner. As Nedumaran trains Aishu, he brews a sinister plan for the resort.

episodesList.title: Durai, the Savior ?
episodesList.summary: Rajan entrusts Vicky with arranging dinner for the investors. Nedumaran plots to take over RR Resort with Luther's help. Vetri waits desperately for Durai, but will he help him?

episodesList.title: Persistant Chef
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran trains Aishu for the competition at home. A stressed Aishu meets Selvin, but she cannot get Vetri out of her mind. Hearing his struggles, Durai agrees to help Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Trial
episodesList.summary: Durai sets to train Vetri if he passes three tests. Vicky informs Nedumaran about Vetri’s move. He tells Vetri he will run the kitchen during the training. Vetri clears two tests.

episodesList.title: The Dead Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri clears Durai's tough task with ease, and he promises to train him. Ragupathi, Riya and Rajan feel betrayed as Vicky executes his plan and shows his colours to the investors.

episodesList.title: Ragupathi's Reassurance
episodesList.summary: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

episodesList.title: Dark Grief
episodesList.summary: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

episodesList.title: Good Luck
episodesList.summary: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Champion Returns
episodesList.summary: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

plotHtml: Set in the fictional RR Resort, the story centers on Vetri, a 12th-fail room service worker who dreams of becoming a professional chef. Despite possessing natural culinary talent, he faces constant humiliation and pressure from a ruthless kitchen hierarchy. Determined to prove himself, Vetri begins challenging the toxic system, navigating friendships, rivalry, and ambition in a high-stakes hospitality environment.
tagline: In a cutthroat resort kitchen, a determined room service worker battles humiliation to pursue his culinary dreams and challenge the toxic hierarchy.

title: Sankalp
summary:
Sankalp is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language socio-political drama streaming television series directed by Prakash Jha and produced by Jyoti Deshpande and Dishaa Jha  under the banner of Jio Studios and PJP Films. It stars Nana Patekar, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Kubbra Sait, Sanjay Kapoor and Neeraj Kabi.

The series premiered on 11 March 2026 on Amazon MX Player.
plot:
Sankalp is an Indian socio-political drama that explores how power is manufactured not through elections, but through mentorship and institutional control. Inspired by the ancient Chanakya-Chandragupta chronicles, the series reimagines political strategy for modern India, where classrooms replace battlefields and bureaucrats replace soldiers. In short, this 10-episode drama reimagines the Chanakya-Chandragupta (mentor-mentee) relation in an imagined situation in contemporary India.
The large part of the serial is based in Patna (Bihar), while there are references to Delhi as well.
The series starts in a slow manner and it remains so all through.
reception:
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India calls it a "A welcome return to basics," and as formulaic as Sankalp is, it's one of those uncannily sketched shows that mines a long-standing culture of reverence and obligation. Archika Khurana of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "With its mix of strategy, ideology and personal conflict, Sankalp ultimately stands as a thought-provoking exploration of how power operates—not just in politics, but in the relationships that shape it."
Bollywood Hungama rated it 2.5/5 stars and writes that "SANKALP rests on a compelling storyline and strong performances by Nana Patekar and the other lead actors. However, the excessive length, silly goings-on and weak climax dilute the impact. Nevertheless, the show should manage to garner viewership due to its mass-appealing treatment and casting." BH Harsh of Cinema Express also gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The Prakash Jha series has its moments, but struggles to maintain momentum with its many subplots."
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 3 stars out of 5 and noted that "'There is a fortune in stolen money, counterfeit notes floating around, and political skullduggery afoot, along with treachery, double dealing, kidnapping and all manner of wickedness packing the series so densely that the pace never flags and a profusion of twists keeps the story engaging even when it strains credibilit." Anuj Kumar of The Hindu observed that "The attempt at subversive social-political inquiry into mentorship and manipulation is diminished by overwriting and tiresome visual and creative contrivances."
Zinia Bandyopadhyay of Firstpost rated it 2.5/5 stars and said that "Sankalp is a show with ambition, ideas and a commanding central performance. But a sprawling narrative and uneven pacing dilute what could have been a far sharper political drama." Free Press Journal's Troy Ribeiro gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Sankalp is an engaging political thriller on mentorship, power and revenge, elevated by strong performances despite occasional narrative imbalance."
B H Harsh from the New Indian Express claimed that "Nana Patekar’s OTT debut lacks energy and coherence."

articleSections.title: Production

The project marks Nana Patekar's debut in the OTT space and is set against a political backdrop, with the actor playing a lawyer-turned-politician while Sanjay Kapoor portrays his close associate. The series was officially unveiled by Jio Studios on 12 April 2023 during its large content slate announcement at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai. Later in development, the show's title was changed and it is now known as "Sankalp".

plotHtml:
Sankalp is an Indian socio-political drama that explores how power is manufactured not through elections, but through mentorship and institutional control. Inspired by the ancient Chanakya-Chandragupta chronicles, the series reimagines political strategy for modern India, where classrooms replace battlefields and bureaucrats replace soldiers. In short, this 10-episode drama reimagines the Chanakya-Chandragupta (mentor-mentee) relation in an imagined situation in contemporary India.
The large part of the serial is based in Patna (Bihar), while there are references to Delhi as well.
The series starts in a slow manner and it remains so all through.
tagline: Sankalp unravels the intricate dance of power and mentorship in modern India, where classrooms become battlefields of strategy and ideology.

title: Thadayam
summary: Thadayam is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language crime thriller streaming television series written and directed by Navinkumar Palanivel for ZEE5. Produced by Ajey Krishna under the banner Cocktail Cinemas, the series stars P. Samuthirakani and Sshivada in lead roles. The narrative is inspired by events reported in 1999 along the Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. The series premiered on 27 February 2026.
plot: Set in 1999, the series follows a series of ritualistic midnight murders in rural villages along the Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. The perpetrator's pattern involves stealing the mangalsutra (thali) from victims, contributing to local fear and speculation. Sub-Inspector Adhiyaman investigates the case alongside Inspector Lakshmi, as they navigate the social and psychological tensions surrounding the crimes.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The official trailer was released on 19 February 2026. The series. streamed on ZEE5 from 27 February 2026 in Tamil.

episodesList.title: The First Case
episodesList.summary: Adhiyaman, a police officer on the waitlist for VRS, investigates a case of theft. Later, when a different village reports a similar incident, SI Adhiyaman observes a startling pattern.

episodesList.title: The Border
episodesList.summary: Unable to find leads in the investigation, Adhiyaman meets the victims of the theft case. Just as he is about to update the inspector about the case, he finds a clue about the culprit’s whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Truth Meets Devil
episodesList.summary: Adhiyaman and his team reach Andhra Pradesh and are shocked to discover a series of murders that follow the same pattern. As they visit the murder locations, more shocking twists await them.

episodesList.title: The Warning
episodesList.summary: The officers receive news about another murder while investigating in Andhra Pradesh. While the team splits up to follow different leads and includes villagers in the search, another life is lost.

episodesList.title: Find The Devil
episodesList.summary: Statements from the survivors confirm Adhiyaman’s theory about the culprit. Meanwhile, the police finds crucial evidence in the last crime scene that helps in their search across the states.

episodesList.title: The Conclusion
episodesList.summary: The evidence leads them to the criminal's last location. As they find more clues of multiple offenders, the police devise a plan to separate the culprits and arrest them. Will Adhiyaman’s plan succeed?

title: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram
summary: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram is an Indian Hindi-language crime thriller drama television series premiered on 3 February 2026 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. It is an official Hindi remake of Star Jalsha's Bengali TV series Parshuram – Ajker Nayok. Produced under Blues Productions, the series stars Shambhavi Singh and Neil Bhatt.
plot: Shiv Prasad Deshmukh is a seemingly ordinary middle-class family man in Maharashtra who lives with his courageous wife Shalini, son Harshit "Chintu" and daughter Riddhi "Pihu". Shalini is revealed to be actually the younger daughter of Malhar Dixit and Deepali Dixit from the elite Dixit family, but she had cut contacts with them, eloped with Shiv and married him against their wishes. While Shalini, Shiv and their kids live happily together, the Dixit family plans to marry off Malhar's younger brother Manish Dixit's daughter, Aradhya Dixit, to Kabir Kulkarni, a rich rogue from the Kulkarni family. Though the Dixits are aware of the fact that Kabir is a criminal, they still want to go ahead with the marriage to improve business relations with Kabir's father, and Aradhya also loves him dearly. Meanwhile, Shalini goes for an outing to a restaurant with Shiv and the kids when some of Kabir's goons try to molest her. She slaps them and berates Shiv for not standing up for her and merely apologizing to them instead. Shiv asks her and the kids to wait outside and thrashes the goons in the restaurant himself, revealing himself to be SPD Parshuram, a special task officer who is actually working undercover as an insurance agent, along with his dialogue, "Vishnu's sixth incarnation Parashurama's weapon was an axe, and the common-man Parshuram's weapon is a six-chambered revolver." While he attacks, Sheetal, an important leader of the mafia criminal underworld who has had a crush on Shiv from college days, is watching him from behind the scenes. She realizes that Shiv is Parshuram, who had posed a great threat to the underworld for a long time, and resolves to capture and destroy him. She says, "Sheetal and smoking, both are injurious to health." and makes contact with Babbar, a bald-headed gangster and an ally of Kabir, who had also tried to bully Shalini before, to help her destroy both Shiv and Shalini. Babbar's goons kidnap Pihu and Chintu, who are saved by Shiv. As he beats up the goons with his usual 'Parshuram' dialogue, Chintu catches him with his revolver and finds out that his dad is Parshuram. Shiv then requests Chintu not to reveal his identity to anyone, including his mother and sister, though the latter had always come close to accidentally revealing Parshuram's identity, only to be signaled by Shiv himself to keep quiet. A worried Shalini files a kidnapping case against Kabir and slaps him. Understanding her feelings, Parshuram secretly catches Babbar, only to find that the latter had escaped with the help of one of his own colleagues. He catches one of Kabir's goons trying to follow Shalini, Pihu and Chintu in their car for evil intentions and thrashes him. Simultaneously, the Dixits are shocked to find out about Shalini's molestation in the restaurant, the Deshmukh kids' kidnapping and the case against Kabir, their future son-in-law. Malhar, Manish, Omkar and Sankalp Dixit set out to resolve the case with the help of CCTV footage from the same restaurant. They are secretly followed by Agent Balram, Parshuram's teammate and college best friend, at the latter's instructions. Meanwhile, Shalini's mother Deepali and elder sister Adv. Nandini suggest they call of the marriage of Kabir and Aradhya in support of Shiv and Shalini but the rest of the family, including Aradhya herself, refuses. Nandini proposes to be Shalini's lawyer against Kabir. Meanwhile, both Shiv and Shalini face threats by many gangsters, including Sheetal, that they will destroy them and their kids. Others threaten them to withdraw the case against Kabir. Chintu is kidnapped again but is saved by Parshuram. Sankalp Dixit finds out about Parshuram from Chintu but is caught and thrashed by Balram and other colleagues of Parshuram. Sheetal makes an assassination attempt on Shiv during Shalini's dance performance but fails. Babbar also tries to assassinate Shiv but the latter escapes. Meanwhile, Manish and his wife Namrata plan to invite Shalini and Shiv to Aradhya and Kabir's wedding to make Shalini confess about the kidnappings. The proposal is initially rejected by Shalini and Shiv but later, the former is manipulated by Aradhya to come. Shalini becomes increasingly worried for her family's safety and tells Nandini that she quits the case but Nandini encourages her to go forward, saying that the law is with her. Meanwhile, Kabir's father, Karan Kulkarni, enters the picture and warns Shalini to withdraw the case against his son, otherwise she and her family will be burnt alive. On the other hand, Parshuram and Balram discover that Sheetal's actual name is Shikha Talwar, a girl from their college days. During Kabir and Aradhya's wedding, Shalini and the kids arrive. Shiv initially departs from there after dropping them, but later returns. Kabir and Aradhya are happily wed, and Shalini and Shiv are still threatened by Karan to withdraw Kabir's case throughout. After the wedding, Kabir's court case is scheduled. Despite the threats, with Nandini's help, Shalini bravely gives the statement against Kabir, who is then sent to prison for 14 days, until the next court session. In revenge, Karan refuses to let Aradhya inside the house and does not consider her his daughter-in-law. He threatens Malhar that he will destroy the Dixit family. The Dixits, including Aradhya herself, blame Shalini for Aradhya's misfortunes and lash out at her supporters, Deepali, Nandini and Shalini's cousin Bhoomika for encouraging her to jail Kabir. Concerned for Aradhya, Shalini takes Shiv to take Aradhya to her in-laws' house. When they reach, Karan forbids them from entering. Shiv Prasad fights Karan's goons (without Shalini or Aradhya's knowledge) and Shalini sends Aradhya inside after defying Karan. With constant encouragement from Advocate Anjali Awasthi, she defends a girl from a man abusing her in a bus.
reception: In its debut week, The show ranked at tenth spot with a TRP of 1.6. In the following week, it got 1.5 TRP. In April 2026, it recorded a TRP of 1.4.

Agent Parshuram: A special task officer working under the cover of an insurance agent; Shalini's husband; Riddhi and Harshit's father * Shambhavi Singh as Shalini Deshmukh: Malhar and Deepali's younger daughter; Shiv's wife; Nandini's sister; Riddhi and Harshit's mother

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Shambhavi Singh was signed to play Shalini. Neil Bhatt confirmed to join the cast to play the dual personality roles of Shiv working as undercover officer Parshuram. Rohit Sharma was cast as Sankalp. Khalid Siddiqui was selected to portray in an antagonist role, Karan. In June 2026, Advocate Anjali Awasthi fame Anshul Bammi was cast in a pivotal role.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The team shot some action sequences in Manali hills in June 2026. Also, they choreographed a romantic dance scene there. Prior to this, Neil Bhatt performed a 'Shantabai' dance sequence on his own as Shivprasad, which filmed in a single take.

articleSections.title: Crossover
articleSections.text: On 23 March 2026, Udne Ki Aasha aired a one-hour special episode called, Deshmukh Vs Deshmukh Mahasangam, wherein Sachin from Udne Ki Aasha got to know about Shiv's dual identity as Parshuram and they both keep it hidden from Sailee and Shalini.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: In its debut week, The show ranked at tenth spot with a TRP of 1.6. In the following week, it got 1.5 TRP. In April 2026, it recorded a TRP of 1.4.

title: Manam
summary:
Manam (transl. Mind) is a 2026 Malaysian Tamil-language Melodrama television series screenplay, written and produced by Seelan Manoheran, directed by SD Puvanendran, starring Jayshree, Surrya Prakash, Subashini, Seelan Manoheran, Mathialagan and Ashwini Nambiar in the lead roles. The show is an official remake of Astro Ria's Malay series Layang-Layang Perkahwinan.
It tells a story of a married couple whose unravels when betrayal, lies, and hidden crimes surface betrayal of one another leads to a whirlwind of revenge, grief, motherhood, survival, forgiveness and healing. It aired on Astro Vinmeen HD on Monday to Thursday at 21:30 (MST) from 2 February to 30 March 2026, and ended with 34 episodes, and is also available on the digital platforms Astro GO and Sooka.
plot:
The story follows Sheena, who is the perfect wife to Varun, who supports her husband Varun’s ascent to top leadership within the company. While juggling her roles as a caring mother, loving wife and responsible daughter-in-law, Sheena keeps the household running seamlessly, even as she manages the pressures of her own career. However, Sheena doesn't realize that she has been cheated on by Varun.
Confronted by Varun’s infidelity, Sheena finds the courage to stand up for herself, even in the face of severe consequences from her influential in-law family. Sheena fights for her dignity, freedom and decides to divorce and meticulously plans her revenge.

articleSections.text: Jayshree as Sheena * Surrya Prakash as Varun * Subashini as Sumi * Seelan Manoheran as Amar * Mathialagan as Selvanayagam * Ashwini Nambiar as Leela

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The show was screenplay, written and produced by Seelan Manoheran under Moviegram Studio Sdn Bhd. He plays the lead role of Amar in this series. The series was directed by SD Puvanendran, and the story-line is inspired by the Malay series Layang-Layang Perkahwinan. And also Astro’s second consecutive Malay to Tamil adaptation after Aadhira series.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Actor Surrya Prakash was cast as the male lead Varun, who cheats on his wife and for his notable performance in Dejavu 375, Yaar Avan and Iraivi Thirumagal Kaadu.
Actress Jayshree plays the lead role as Leena in the series. Subashini was played as Sumi, who is an aiffiar with Varun and trun to his second wife. Actor Seelan Manoheran, who produced and wrote the series, also plays the role of Amar, as Leena's well-wisher. Actor Mathialagan and Ashwini Nambiar portrayed Selvanayagam and Leela, the parents of Varun.

title: Dr. Aarambhi
summary: Dr. Aarambhi is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on Colors TV on 27 January 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Mukta Dhond under Malhar Content Creations, starring Aishwarya Khare, Arjit Taneja, Aditya Redij and Anjum Fakih. The series is loose adaptation of the K-drama, Doctor Cha.
plot:
Dr. Aarambhi Chaudhary, a brilliant gold medallist and AIPMT topper, stands at the threshold of a promising medical career when she chooses to set it aside after marriage. Devoting herself entirely to her new family, she embraces the roles of dutiful daughter-in-law, supportive wife, and caring mother, quietly shelving her own ambitions to nurture her household.
As the years pass, her husband, Dr. Vishwas Tandon, rises to prominence as the celebrated face of their medical legacy, while Aarambhi's sacrifices remain unseen. The fragile balance of her life shatters when she discovers his affair with Dr. Avantika Mehta. Confronted by betrayal and emotional manipulation, Aarambhi is forced to reevaluate the choices that defined her identity. Refusing to remain in the shadows any longer, she resolves to reclaim her independence, return to medicine, and rebuild her life on her own terms.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Aishwarya Khare as Dr. Aarambhi Chaudhary: Balbir and Manju's daughter; Arun's sister; Vishwas's estranged wife; Dhruv's love interest; Vihaan's mother; Avantika's rival (2026–present) *Arjit Taneja as Dhruv Chawla: Dev and Mrs. Chawla's son; Nyra's brother; Kunika's grandson; Aarambhi's love interest; Vishwas and Avantika's rival (2026–present) * Aditya Redij as Dr. Vishwas Tandon: Co-owner of NeoPulse Hospital; Sunil and Dimple's elder son; Raj's brother; Aarambhi's estranged husband; Avantika's boyfriend; Vihaan and Sania's father (2026–present) * Anjum Fakih as Dr. Avantika Mehta: Vishwas's girlfriend; Sania's mother; Aarambhi's rival (2026–present)

articleSections.title: Special appearances
articleSections.text: Ayesha Singh as Mannat Khanna from Mannat – Har Khushi Paane Ki (2026) *Adnan Khan as Vikrant Saluja from Mannat – Har Khushi Paane Ki (2026) *Mona Vasu as Aishwarya Khanna Raisingh from Mannat – Har Khushi Paane Ki (2026) *Sharain Khanduja as Mallika Raisingh from Mannat – Har Khushi Paane Ki (2026)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In December 2025, Anjum Fakih was announced enter the series as Dr. Avantika. In April, Sumit Singh portraying Dr. Manmeet was replaced without prior notice. Arjit Taneja entered the show in May 2026 to portray Dhruv.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's New Beginnings
episodesList.summary: Meet Aarambhi, a housewife and one-time AIPMT topper, rushing to her son Vihaan's project day. As Vishwas wins a medical award, crediting her, will destiny revive her career?

episodesList.title: Vishwas's Grand Proposal
episodesList.summary: Vishwas plans a grand proposal for Avantika, but Aarambhi mistakenly believes it's for her and accepts it. Later, Vishwas assures Avantika that he will divorce Aarambhi.

episodesList.title: Vishwas Betrays Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Vishwas prioritises Avantika and meets her instead of Aarambhi's mother Manju, breaking his promise. Later, Radhika and Vihaan drop Aarambhi at the airport and wish her luck.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Medical Crisis
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi faints mid-flight and is rushed to the hospital by Manmeet. Later, Vishwas treats her as Avantika witnesses their closeness and feels a sting of jealousy.

episodesList.title: Manmeet Warns of Death
episodesList.summary: Manmeet warns Aarambhi that she might die without a transplant. Later, Aarambhi consoles Vihaan, assuring him nothing will happen to her.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Betrayed at the Brink
episodesList.summary: Radhika urges Aarambhi to meet Vishwas to save herself. Later, Aarambhi is shattered when she overhears Vishwas rejoicing over his fate to be with Avantika.

episodesList.title: Vishwas's Cold-Blooded Ambition
episodesList.summary: Vishwas admits to Avantika that Aarambhi's death would solve his custody battle once and for all. Later, he outlines his ruthless plan to marry Avantika by removing his wife.

episodesList.title: Manmeet's Selfless Stand
episodesList.summary: Manmeet warns Manju about the fragile state of Vishwas and Aarambhi's relationship. Later, she undergoes medical tests to see if she can donate a kidney to Aarambhi.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Radhika angrily confronts Vishwas for refusing to donate his kidney to Aarambhi. Later, Vishwas and Avantika are shocked to learn that Aarambhi has found a kidney donor.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi is taken into the operating theatre for her kidney transplant. After the surgery, she regains consciousness and breaks down, devastated by Vishwas's betrayal.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Opens Up to Radhika
episodesList.summary: Manju thanks Vishwas, thinking he arranged a donor for Aarambhi. Later, Aarambhi confides in Radhika about Vishwas's betrayal and vows to rebuild her life for Vihaan's custody.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Life-Changing Decision
episodesList.summary: Vishwas announces his decision to relocate to Mumbai, pretending it is for Aarambhi's health. Determined to restart her life, Aarambhi decides to renew her medical licence.

episodesList.title: Tandons' Family Celebration
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi decides to become a doctor while staying with Vishwas and the Tandons. Later, the Tandons celebrate their hospital's top ranking in India and plan to expand their legacy.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Seeks the Donor's Truth
episodesList.summary: Manmeet stops Aarambhi from travelling, calling her medically unfit. Later, Aarambhi bribes a staff member to uncover the secret identity of her donor.

episodesList.title: Manju Seeks Aarambhi's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Manju apologises to Aarambhi for arranging her match with Vishwas. Later, Vishwas asks Avantika for time to sort things out and end his marriage arrangement with Aarambhi.

episodesList.title: Koushiki's Decision to Part Ways
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise when Koushiki demands Arun sign the divorce papers, sparking a heated family argument. Later, Aarambhi urges Arun to understand Koushiki and resolve their issues.

episodesList.title: Vishwas Doubts Aarambhi's Moves
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi struggles to pay her fees and finds the diamond necklace Vishwas gifted is fake. Later, he grows suspicious, learning of Aarambhi's visit to the Medical Council office.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Silent Battle
episodesList.summary: As Vishwas visits, Aarambhi fears he has learned about her visit to the Medical Council office. Later, she decides to act normally with Vishwas until she secures Vihaan's custody.

episodesList.title: Vihaan Confronts Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi worries as the house Puja and her medical license reapplication exam timings clash. Later, Vihaan questions Vishwas for not adding Aarambhi's name to the house nameplate.

episodesList.title: Vishwas's Dark Intent
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi notices Vishwas prioritising Avantika during the Puja, making her feel betrayed and saddened. Later, Vishwas deliberately and secretly injures Avantika's hand.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Exam Battle
episodesList.summary: As Aarambhi cannot hold the kalash with her injured hand, Avantika performs the Kalash Puja. Later, Aarambhi reaches the exam centre but struggles to write due to her injury.

episodesList.title: Dimple Insults Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Vishwas plans to take over Vihaan's custody, while the invigilator refuses Aarambhi's bloodstained exam paper. Later, Dimple taunts Aarambhi for lacking class and standards.

episodesList.title: Vishwas Fumes at Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Vishwas snatches his draft divorce paper from Vihaan before Aarambhi sees it and fumes at her about parenting. Later, Soundarya comes to work as a cook at Vishwas's house.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Suspicion About Saniya
episodesList.summary: Talking with Soundarya, Aarambhi finds the strength to fight and rebuild her life for Vihaan. Later, she begins to suspect Saniya is Avantika and Vishwas's daughter.

episodesList.title: Vishwas, Avantika Face-Off
episodesList.summary: Manmeet and Raj cross paths as she arrives searching for a room to stay. Meanwhile, Vishwas and Avantika argue about enrolling Saniya and Vihaan in the same school.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Takes Up the Nurse's Role
episodesList.summary: Manmeet confronts Raj, accusing him of complaining about her to Dimple. Later, Aarambhi feels delighted when Kuldeep informs her that she can work as a nurse to treat Kunika.

episodesList.title: Dimple Hits Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi cleverly tricks Kunika into agreeing to take the injection. Later, Dimple slaps Aarambhi for letting Vihaan play Holi with Anantha and warns her to stay away.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Walks Out
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi hears the painful truth about what the Tandons really think of her. Later, she chooses her dignity and walks out of the house after Vishwas's betrayal.

episodesList.title: Raj Supports Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Raj defies Dimple and stands by Aarambhi despite the threat to evict her. Later, Aarambhi manages the house and her duties as a harsh truth about domestic abuse shakes the family.

episodesList.title: Vishwas Faces Avantika's Wish
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi teases Raj after he accidentally spills colour on Manmeet at the Holi party. Later, she breaks down when she sees Avantika asking Vishwas to apply Sindoor to her.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Outsmarts Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Manmeet and Raj celebrate Holi with joy and dance at the party. Later, Aarambhi foils Vishwas's plan by swapping the Sindoor with synthetic colour, triggering an allergic reaction.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Races to Save Manmeet
episodesList.summary: Dimple blames Aarambhi for carelessly bringing artificial Holi colours. Meanwhile, Aarambhi follows a car after spotting three men abducting an unconscious Manmeet.

episodesList.title: Manmeet in Danger
episodesList.summary: Avantika vows to win Vishwas's love over Aarambhi. Raj's friends attempt to misbehave with Manmeet, but guided by her prayers, Aarambhi reaches the farmhouse. Can she save Manmeet?

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Fumes at Karthik
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi stands by Manmeet after Karthik misbehaves with her. As Raj claims innocence and Nandita falsely blames Manmeet, Aarambhi urges Raj to support her in seeking justice.

episodesList.title: Dimple's Surprising Decision
episodesList.summary: Saniya calls Vishwas as Avantika faints, prompting Vishwas and Dimple to visit her. Aarambhi is shocked when Dimple announces that Avantika and Saniya will stay with them.

episodesList.title: Vishwas's Assurance to Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi informs Vishwas about Manmeet, and he promises to handle it. The Tandon family grows anxious about their hospital legacy after hearing the news.

episodesList.title: Manmeet Battles Fake Claims
episodesList.summary: The Tandons accuse Manmeet of intoxication and blackmailing intern doctors. Aarambhi senses trouble for Manmeet after realising their plan to keep her away from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Stands for Manmeet
episodesList.summary: Manmeet confronts Aarambhi for not supporting her after Avantika provokes her. Aarambhi then vows to the Tandon family that she will prove Manmeet's innocence.

episodesList.title: Vishwas Confronts Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Avantika tells the Tandons that Dr. Manmeet has agreed to leave the hospital. Vishwas confronts Aarambhi, insisting that Manmeet is guilty.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Supports Manmeet
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi stands strong for Manmeet and works to prove her innocence. Manmeet makes shocking revelations about Raj's betrayal in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Will Aarambhi Save Mannat?
episodesList.summary: Mannat fails to expose Arzoo's truth and plots to deceive Vishakha, while an angry Vishwas throws Aarambhi out of his life. Soon, Aarambhi spots a car rushing toward Mannat!

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Uplift Each Other
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Aarambhi share their struggles and pain, draw strength from each other, and resolve to fight together for their children's safety and a secure future.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi Unite
episodesList.summary: Vishwas throws Aarambhi out, but she fights back legally. As Mannat spirals in fear, she turns to Aarambhi for help to expose Arzoo's dark secrets.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Steal Spotlight
episodesList.summary: The Tandons arrive at Vikrant and Yashika's Sangeet. Mannat and Aarambhi dance together joyfully, and later Mannat makes Vishwas realise Aarambhi's importance.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi Outsmarts Avantika
episodesList.summary: Dhairya, Aarambhi, and Mannat plot to get Arzoo admitted to the hospital, while Aarambhi smartly pushes Avantika to handle the party responsibilities to impress the Saluja family.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Aarambhi attempt to alter Arzoo's lab reports to reveal her true identity as Aishwarya. They plan to make Arzoo's health condition seem serious without harming her.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat's Faith in Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi decides to attend her doctor's license renewal interview despite the risks. Mannat encourages her and diverts Yashika's attention when she tries to spy on them.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi's Gratitude to Mannat
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi feels thankful to Mannat for sending Vishwas out of the interview cabin. When Dimple blames Aarambhi for party issues, Mannat tries to expose Avantika.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Arzoo's Collapse Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Mannat and Aarambhi's plan succeeds when Arzoo suddenly collapses, causing panic. Accusations rise as tensions explode among everyone.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Yashika, Vikrant's Wedding Drama
episodesList.summary: As Vikrant and Yashika clash over cancelling the wedding, past love between Vikrant and Mannat resurfaces. Meanwhile, Aarambhi alters Arzoo's medical reports, leaving her in shock.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Outplay Arzoo
episodesList.summary: Raj promises Manmeet to keep her kidney donation a secret from Aarambhi. Arzoo unknowingly walks into Mannat and Aarambhi's trap after Malla is found to be an incompatible donor.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Vikrant's Heart Gets Divided Again
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's emotions spiral as Dua's arrival sparks joy, leaving Mannat hurt and furious. As truths unravel, Aarambhi's secrets fuel intense drama.

episodesList.title: Mahasangam: Mannat Trapped in Arzoo's Plot
episodesList.summary: As Mannat faints, Malla and Vishakha lock her in a trunk as per Arzoo's plan, leaving Dhairya and Aarambhi worried. Soon, Yashika and Vikrant begin their wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Clashes With Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Vikrant abandons his wedding to find Mannat as shocking truths come out. Aarambhi's bold confession sparks conflict with her family, leading to a heated clash with Vishwas.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Escape Against All Odds
episodesList.summary: Trapped by Vishwas, Aarambhi races against time as she cleverly turns Vihaan into her only hope of escape. With danger closing in, her desperate move changes everything.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Moment to Shine
episodesList.summary: Dr. Yadav gives Aarambhi a chance to prove herself by handling an emergency case. Vishwas comforts Avantika when she panics after learning about Saniya's accident.

episodesList.title: Saniya's Truth Shocks Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: As a bus accident leaves Saniya battling for life, families rush to the hospital, and tensions rise. Aarambhi is shaken when she learns Saniya is Vishwas' daughter.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Decides to Fight Back
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi is shattered after learning Saniya's secret and recalling Vishwas always siding with Avantika. Vishwas lashes out at the doctor, while Aarambhi stands up for herself.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Bold Move Stuns Vishwas
episodesList.summary: Vishwas and Dimple are shocked to learn Aarambhi has renewed her medical license. As tensions escalate in the hospital, Avantika accuses Aarambhi of harming Saniya.

episodesList.title: Can Aarambhi Clear Her Name?
episodesList.summary: Avantika calls the police, while Vishwas sees a chance to oust Aarambhi from their lives. The police arrest Aarambhi on charges of negligence. How will she prove her innocence?

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Confronts Avantika
episodesList.summary: Saniya's reports prove Aarambhi's innocence, and she confronts Avantika for blaming her for Saniya's allergy. The doctor assures Aarambhi that her medical license is safe.

episodesList.title: Sunil Fumes at Dimple
episodesList.summary: Sunil lashes out at Dimple for not watching over Aarambhi and ruining the Tandon family's prestige. Dimple urges Vishwas to control Aarambhi and keep her within limits.

episodesList.title: Shocking News for Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi boldly faces Sunil and Dimple's accusations as tensions rise at home. Manmeet tells her that the medical council doesn't allow her to practice in Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Manju's Plea to Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Manju urges Aarambhi to compromise on her dreams and obey Vishwas. Vishwas tells Dimple that no one in Mumbai will hire Aarambhi for her medical practice.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Clever Plot
episodesList.summary: Executing her plan, Aarambhi locks Avantika in a storeroom. As Dimple and Nandita kick off their podcast, they're stunned to see Aarambhi arrive as the guest instead of Avantika.

episodesList.title: Dimple Probes Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Avantika struggles in the locked storeroom while Vishwas gets furious watching Aarambhi's podcast. Aarambhi smartly handles Dimple's trap questions meant to put her down.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi Shines on Podcast
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi impresses all with her confident podcast appearance, sharing her wish to revive her medical career. Soon, Dimple confronts her for taking Avantika's place.

episodesList.title: Sunil Supports Aarambhi's Career
episodesList.summary: Sunil grants Aarambhi permission to resume her medical practice at the hospital. However, Vishwas delivers a surprising twist as she must train under Avantika's direct supervision.

episodesList.title: Aarambhi's Strong Resolve
episodesList.summary: Aarambhi decides to stand strong against Vishwas and Avantika's moves, refusing to lose hope for Vihaan. She then teaches Vihaan self-reliance while facing family criticism.

episodesList.title: Soundarya Gives Aarambhi Strength
episodesList.summary: As Aarambhi feels unsure about beginning her medical practice, Soundarya empowers her. Then, Avantika purposely assigns Aarambhi a punishment in an attempt to insult her.

episodesList.title: Vihaan Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Dimple arranges Raj's roka ceremony without his consent. Vishwas takes Vihaan out for lunch, after which Vihaan goes missing, causing Vishwas to panic and search for him.

episodesList.title: Balbir senses Aarambhi's trouble
episodesList.summary: Vishwas confides in Aarambhi about Tandon family's financial crisis. Through Vihaan, Balbir learns that Aarambhi is troubled.

episodesList.title: Manju's advice to Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Manju stops Aarambhi from opposing the family's dowry demands. Avantika arrives in disguise with the media as Dimple and Sunil advice Vishwas to keep an eye on Aarambhi.

episodesList.title: Can Aarambhi foil the dowry plan?
episodesList.summary: Nayra's parents tell Aarambhi that the gifts for Nayra are a token of love, not dowry. Meanwhile, police prepare to catch the Tandons red-handed during the dowry exchange.

episodesList.title: Naira's shocking discovery
episodesList.summary: Dimple locks Aarambhi in a room to stop her from exposing the dowry secret. Meanwhile, the police reveal the truth to Nayra, leaving her shocked that her parents are giving dowry.

episodesList.title: Naira's big move
episodesList.summary: Dhruv threatens to expose the truth about the dowry while Naira goes missing. She later returns with the police.

episodesList.title: Naira exposes the truth
episodesList.summary: Naira publicly accuses the Tandon family of accepting dowry from her father. While Sunil defends the family by calling it a charitable donation, Dhruv speaks for Naira.

episodesList.title: Dhruv opposes Aarambhi
episodesList.summary: Dhruv stands against Aarambhi as she tries to save Nayra and Raj's relationship. Later, the media's questions over the dowry allegations leave Vishwas furious.

episodesList.title: The Tandons in trouble
episodesList.summary: The police arrive with proof to arrest the Tandons for taking dowry from Nayra's family. Later, Balbir rebukes Nayra's parents for agreeing to give dowry.

plotHtml:
Dr. Aarambhi Chaudhary, a brilliant gold medallist and AIPMT topper, stands at the threshold of a promising medical career when she chooses to set it aside after marriage. Devoting herself entirely to her new family, she embraces the roles of dutiful daughter-in-law, supportive wife, and caring mother, quietly shelving her own ambitions to nurture her household.
As the years pass, her husband, Dr. Vishwas Tandon, rises to prominence as the celebrated face of their medical legacy, while Aarambhi's sacrifices remain unseen. The fragile balance of her life shatters when she discovers his affair with Dr. Avantika Mehta. Confronted by betrayal and emotional manipulation, Aarambhi is forced to reevaluate the choices that defined her identity. Refusing to remain in the shadows any longer, she resolves to reclaim her independence, return to medicine, and rebuild her life on her own terms.
tagline: Aarambhi's journey from self-sacrifice to self-rediscovery ignites as betrayal shatters her world, pushing her to reclaim her medical dreams.

title: Wheel of Fortune India
summary:
Wheel of Fortune India is an Indian Hindi-language television game show based on the American television format Wheel of Fortune. The series is produced by Frames Production Company and is being broadcast on Sony Entertainment Television. Actor Akshay Kumar serves as the host of the programme.
The programme marks the entry of the Wheel of Fortune franchise into Indian television and adapts the original format for Indian audiences.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text:
Wheel of Fortune India follows the core format of the international franchise, using the UK version's rule set. Contestants spin a large wheel to determine cash values and attempt to solve word puzzles by guessing letters. Correct guesses allow contestants to accumulate winnings, while incorrect spins may result in penalties such as loss of turn or loss of accumulated amounts.
The Indian adaptation features Hindi-language puzzles and culturally relevant categories while retaining the structure of the original format.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Sony Pictures Networks India acquired the Indian adaptation rights to Wheel of Fortune from the format owners and commissioned Frames Production Company to produce the series.
Akshay Kumar was announced as the host ahead of the programme's premiere.His co-host is named Elnaaz Norouzi.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Wheel of Fortune India is scheduled to premiere on 27 January 2026 on Sony Entertainment Television. Episodes will also be made available on SonyLIV, the network's digital streaming platform. Due to its short-lived run, on 13 April 2026, it was announcedthat another gameshow Tum Ho Naa (You're Here, Aren't You?) hosted by Rajeev Khandelwal will replace it. It premieres on 28 April 2026. As per the reports the 2nd Season Of Wheel Of Fortune Of India will Possibly be Coming in Jan 2027 (as teased on finale episode) and it will be hosted by Akshay Kumar again. So stay tuned.
