title: Lakshmi Niwas
summary: Lakshmi Niwas is an Indian Hindi-language  family drama television series which premiered on 12 January 2026 on Zee TV. Produced by Rashmi Sharma Telefilms, the series is a remake of the Kannada drama Lakshmi Nivasa from Zee Kannada. It stars Manasi Joshi Roy, and Rajendra Chawla.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Manasi Joshi Roy as Lakshmi Jaiswal: Shrinivas's wife (2026–present) * Rajendra Chawla as Srinivas Jaiswal: Lakshmi's husband (2026–present) * Akshita Mudgal as Radhika Chauhan (née Jaiswal): Lakshmi and Shrinivas's middle daughter; Veer's wife (2026–present) * Raghav Tiwari as Veer Chauhan: Gajendra and Nalini's son; Radhika's husband (2026–present) * Riya Munjal as Bhoomika Bundela (née Jaiswal): Lakshmi and Shrinivas's youngest daughter (2026–present) * Priom Gujjar as Raj Bundela: Bhoomika's husband (2026–present)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Manasi Joshi Roy and Rajendra Chawla confirmed to play Lakshmi and Srinivas. Akshita Mudgal was selected to play Radhika. Gashmeer Mahajani was chosen to play Aditya.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas’s Dream and Lakshmi’s Concern
episodesList.summary: As retirement nears, Shriniwas dreams of building a home to honour his wife Lakshmi’s long-held vow. Meanwhile, Lakshmi is weighed down by the responsibility of daughters’ impending marriages.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi is Saddened As Radhika’s Alliance Fails
episodesList.summary: The morning after Lakshmi’s birthday brings gloom, yet Shriniwas consoles her over Radhika’s broken alliance. Meanwhile, Aditya’s mother finds a life partner for him!

episodesList.title: A Marriage Proposal For Radhika
episodesList.summary: Veer, Gajendra’s younger son, makes cunning moves to secure his father’s election victory. Meanwhile, Aditya’s mother Vandana brings a proposal for Radhika to Lakshmi, leaving her lost in thought.

episodesList.title: Will Radhika Agree to Marry Aditya?
episodesList.summary: An argument breaks out over Aditya’s marriage proposal for Radhika, who then announces her decision. Some goons attack Veer at the temple, and Lakshmi gets worried after witnessing a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Radhika’s Alliance is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Aditya’s family visits Lakshmi, who then informs them about the flaw in Radhika’s horoscope. Vandana finalises Aditya and Radhika’s alliance, but Aditya’s sister Isha is unhappy with the match.

episodesList.title: Isha’s Demand to Lakshmi Over The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Isha arrives at Lakshmi’s home and pressures her to ensure the wedding is perfect. Lakshmi discusses the expenses with Sriniwas, who conceals his contribution to his friend Shankar’s treatment.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Grows Anxious Over Finances
episodesList.summary: At office, Aditya announces his marriage to Radhika. Meanwhile, a pundit suggests an auspicious date just four days away. After Shankar’s death, Shriniwas grows anxious about arranging the money.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Radhika Spend Time Together
episodesList.summary: Vivek and Varun dodge wedding expenses with excuses, while Manish offers Lakshmi support, but Meenakshi intervenes. Aditya and Radhika treasure moments together before their marriage.

episodesList.title: Radhika Worries For Lakshmi and Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Raju spots Vivek and Varun smoking together. Radhika grows uneasy as she sees Lakshmi and Shriniwas worried about the wedding. Later, Isha calls Lakshmi, and her words intensify Lakshmi’s worry.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Meets Veer At The Temple
episodesList.summary: Gajendra entrusts Veer with Alok’s work. At the temple, Lakshmi recalls a vow after encountering her brother and sister-in-law. Suddenly, she falls ill, and Veer miraculously steps in to support her.

episodesList.title: Sriniwas Takes a Loan For Radhika’s Wedding
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi gives her jewellery to Sriniwas to sell and asks the family to prepare for the wedding. Elsewhere, Adhitya buys a ring for Radhika. Later, Sriniwas mortgages the land papers to take a loan.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi and Shriniwas Visit Gajendra’s House
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika tells Radhika her idea of a prince charming. Lakshmi buys sarees for her daughters-in-law, while Raju lovingly purchases one for her. Later, Lakshmi and Shriniwas visit Gajendra’s house.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Insults Shriniwas and Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Gajendra and his mother insult Shriniwas and Lakshmi when they come with Radhika's wedding card. At the office, Shriniwas faces a shocking revelation, while Varun fumes seeing Bhoomika with Kunal.

episodesList.title: Aditya Heads Off to His Wedding!
episodesList.summary: Radhika gets ready for her wedding as Aditya drives off with Vandana. Meanwhile, Isha frets over being unable to stop their marriage, and Akhil waits for his dangerous plan to unfold!

episodesList.title: Radhika is Blamed For Aditya’s Accident
episodesList.summary: On the way to the wedding, a truck crashes into Aditya’s car, which then collides with Veer’s. Akhil rejoices at his ploy’s success, but Veer blames himself, and at the hospital, Radhika is blamed.

episodesList.title: Aditya and Vandana Breathe Their Last
episodesList.summary: At Gajendra’s order, Kishor bribes a doctor to mislead Veer that Aditya’s family is safe. Soon, Radhika and her family are shattered to learn Aditya and Vandana are dead, as Akhil and Isha blame her.

episodesList.title: Radhika Stands Tall For Niya
episodesList.summary: The doctor reveals how a man saved Niya, yet she cannot walk. Radhika defends her against Isha and brings her home, while Akhil accepts money from Kishor, letting him believe Veer caused the accident.

episodesList.title: Niya’s Longing and Akhil’s Shocking Act
episodesList.summary: Radhika’s family consoles Niya as she longs for Aditya and Vandana. Akhil’s shocking revelation of performing their last rites alone stuns Lakshmi and Shriniwas, while Isha vows revenge on Radhika.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Decision Stirs Chaos
episodesList.summary: Veer confides in Nandini after the tragic incident. Radhika’s decision to keep Niya in the house stirs chaos. Later, Shriniwas supports Radhika.

episodesList.title: A News Item Troubles Gajendra
episodesList.summary: Veer comes face-to-face with Radhika during a brawl and thanks the goddess for catching a glimpse of her. Kunal insists Bhoomika to attend the college fest. A scandalous news item troubles Gajendra.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Plans to Meet Lakshmi and Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Gajendra, worried for Veer after hearing of Aditya’s accident from Aishwarya, decides to visit Lakshmi and Shriniwas. Meanwhile, Veer again encounters Radhika while helping college students.

episodesList.title: Gajendra Visits Shriniwas' House For Answers
episodesList.summary: Veer is amazed to meet Radhika again. She inspires Bhoomika to join the fest, while Vijendra wishes Kunal luck. With Nalini, Gajendra visits Shriniwas, quietly seeking details of Aditya’s accident.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s Unexpected Meeting With Raj Bundela
episodesList.summary: Gajendra is relieved that Radhika’s family knows little about Aditya’s accident. Meanwhile, Bhoomika meets dynamic industrialist Raj Bundela while preparing her welcome speech for the college fest.

episodesList.title: A Call From Isha’s Lawyer Sparks Panic
episodesList.summary: Akhil’s mother moves into Isha’s home, but a call from her lawyer sparks panic. Raj shocks Bhoomika’s family by entering her house with his men, while Kunal is busy with his friends at college.

episodesList.title: Aditya’s will Worries Isha and Akhil
episodesList.summary: Raj shocks Bhoomika’s family by proposing marriage on his first visit. Aditya’s first will stuns Akhil and his mother, while Isha doubts Niya can return. Radhika fears Veer, but he is drawn to her.

episodesList.title: Radhika Cornered By The Police
episodesList.summary: At college, Bhoomika shocks Kunal by revealing Raj’s marriage proposal. As police summon Radhika and Niya, Lakshmi and Shriniwas are arrested, leaving Radhika trapped by a cruel ultimatum.

episodesList.title: Akhil’s Mother Snatches Niya From Radhika
episodesList.summary: Shockingly, an inspector lets Akhil’s mother snatch Niya from Radhika and leave with him and Isha, and later forces Radhika to sign a paper. At night, Lakshmi and Shriniwas wonder who bailed them out.

episodesList.title: Veer Trails Radhika to Lakshmi’s House
episodesList.summary: Isha stays unaware as Akhil and his mother torture Niya to keep her fearful and obedient. Veer follows Radhika to her locality, where Lakshmi welcomes him home, and he ends up saving Janaki’s life.

episodesList.title: Akhil and His Mother Harass Niya
episodesList.summary: Akhil and his mother sack the household staff and harass Niya by forcing her into chores. Meanwhile, Veer follows Radhika to her office, trying desperately to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Akhil and Isha Fire Radhika From The Job
episodesList.summary: At the office, Radhika misses Niya and Aditya, but Akhil and Isha fire her. Later, the moneylender warns Shriniwas he’ll seize his land if the loan isn’t repaid and a worried Shriniwas returns home.

episodesList.title: Mr Beniwal’s Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas reveals the danger to his land, while Akhil celebrates. The next day, a stunning twist unfolds as Mr Beniwal returns the land, and Lakshmi and Shriniwas leave for Raj Bundela’s office.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Proposal and Kunal’s Confession
episodesList.summary: Raj’s secret help comes to light as Lakshmi and Shriniwas consider his proposal for Bhoomika. Kunal is unsure if Bhoomika heard his confession. Veer asks Radhika’s name, but she misunderstands him.

episodesList.title: Niya Sends Radhika a Message
episodesList.summary: As Bhoomika’s family considers Raj’s proposal, Kunal’s friends stop him from a fight and urge him to win her trust. At night, Radhika hears Niya’s message, but is insulted on visiting her with laddus.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Bold Move to Meet Niya
episodesList.summary: With favourable feedback on Raj, the family plans to move ahead with the proposal, but Bhoomika faces uncertainty. The next day, Radhika sneaks into Isha and Akhil’s party as a waitress to meet Niya.

episodesList.title: Radhika Saves Niya From Harm
episodesList.summary: At Isha’s party, Radhika is pained to see Akhil and his mother mistreat Niya. She rescues her, but Isha blocks the way. Meanwhile, Veer avoids a proposed match as his heart still longs for Radhika.

episodesList.title: Kunal is Hurt As Bhoomika Chooses Raj
episodesList.summary: Kunal’s confession goes awry when Bhoomika misreads his intentions, and her family begins to support Raj’s proposal. Meanwhile, Veer receives unexpected news that heightens the growing tension.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s New Beginning and Kunal’s Dark Night
episodesList.summary: As Bhoomika’s family prepares for her engagement with Raj, Kunal quietly fights his heartbreak. Meanwhile, Lakshmi suggests an idea to support Radhika, who is deeply troubled by Niya’s distress.

episodesList.title: Kunal Finds a Reason to Forget Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Raj and Bhoomika get engaged as Kunal’s aunt urges him to forget Bhoomika, citing Lakshmi’s past. The next day, Raj visits Bhoomika for her birthday, while Siddhu meets Veer to help impress Radhika.

episodesList.title: Veer Sees Radhika Outside Aditya’s Bungalow
episodesList.summary: Raj takes Bhoomika out on her birthday, while Kunal realises how strongly his family fears love. Siddhu guides Veer on winning Radhika over, but Veer is stunned to see her outside Aditya’s bungalow.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Secret Entry With Veer
episodesList.summary: With Veer’s support, Radhika sneaks into Aditya’s house to meet Niya but Akhil’s mother turns her away. Kunal’s friends visit him, while Raj takes Bhoomika on a chartered flight on her birthday.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Sadness Unsettles Veer
episodesList.summary: Veer sees Radhika leaving Aditya’s bungalow and decides to know the reason behind her sadness. Bhoomika celebrates her birthday abroad with Raj, while Shriniwas learns from Lakshmi about Raj’s visit.

episodesList.title: Veer's Trick to Make Radhika Smile
episodesList.summary: Veer uses a trick to make Radhika smile. Raj drops Bhoomika home and exchanges numbers with her. Meanwhile, Kunal’s friends urge him to stop her wedding, but his aunt tells them to let him move on.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Feels Close to Raj
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika grows emotionally close to Raj, unaware that Kunal is sinking into heartbreak. Veer worries about cheering Radhika up as she fears for Niya, who faces cruelty from Akhil and his mother.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika and Raj’s Wedding Shopping Trip
episodesList.summary: Akhil’s mother locks Niya in a room as punishment, while Isha searches for her. Meanwhile, at Raj’s urging, Bhoomika’s family goes wedding shopping at a mall, where Veer spots Radhika and follows her.

episodesList.title: Isha Is Angered by Akhil’s Comments
episodesList.summary: Veer feels glad as Radhika thanks him for rescuing her from the lift. While shopping, Bhoomika tells Raj about Niya. Later, Isha saves Niya from the attic and is upset by Akhil’s remarks about Aditya.

episodesList.title: Niya Flees Home on Holi to Reach Radhika
episodesList.summary: Kunal attempts suicide after learning Bhoomika is falling for Raj as Devika overhears Veer’s plan to celebrate Holi with Radhika. As the Jaiswals celebrate, Niya flees home to reach Radhika.

episodesList.title: Niya Runs Into Veer
episodesList.summary: Niya runs into Veer, who helps her call Radhika and feeds her. Akhil and Isha halt the Jaiswals’ celebration when Niya goes missing. Veer’s friends tease him, until something unexpected happens.

episodesList.title: A Startling Revelation About Aditya's Will
episodesList.summary: Radhika thanks Veer on a call for saving Niya and he introduces himself as Mr. Chauhan. Meanwhile, the lawyer’s revelation about Aditya’s will pushes Isha and Akhil to invite her against their wishes.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Hidden Gift for Radhika
episodesList.summary: Isha calls Radhika at night, but Lakshmi says they will meet her in person. Devika grows wary when Veer carries a gajra, and before Raj and Bhoomika’s yagya, he quietly tucks it into Radhika’s hair.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi's Demand Shocks Everyone
episodesList.summary: Devika asks Veer for the name of the woman he loves, and then the family gathers to pick a match for him. Later, Lakshmi visits Isha’s home and makes a demand for Radhika that leaves everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Veer Crosses Paths With Radhika Again
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi’s family is amazed by her talent, while Akhil secretly reaches out to Gajendra. Veer dodges Gajendra’s push to choose a match and runs into Radhika, as Raj takes Bhoomika to a surprise spot.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas' Family Visits Gajendra With a Request
episodesList.summary: Devika feels uneasy when Gajendra agrees to attend Bhoomika and Raj's wedding at Shriniwas' request. Later, the Jaiswals welcome Revati's mother Sarla, and Raj joins them for a warm family dinner.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika's Haldi Brings Pain for Kunal
episodesList.summary: The Jaiswals gather for Raj and Bhoomika's Haldi, while Kunal hides his grief as Vijendra asks him to prepare to visit the registrar's office. Meanwhile, Veer's plan fails when Akhil spots his men.

episodesList.title: Radhika Invites Veer to Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Despite Devika calling her jinxed, Bhoomika and Raj include Radhika in the Haldi. Veer keeps calling Radhika, unaware she’s the one he seeks. Later, urged by Niya, she invites him to the wedding.

episodesList.title: Veer Meets Radhika at Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: The Jaiswals warmly welcome the Chauhans for the wedding. Meanwhile, Veer’s chance meeting with Lakshmi leads him to the ceremony, but Radhika’s snap judgment could change everything!

episodesList.title: Veer Caught Between Revelations
episodesList.summary: Veer is stunned when Lakshmi introduces him to Radhika and feels perplexed on learning Aishwarya is her daughter‑in‑law. Meanwhile, Gajendra calls Akhil at the same wedding to hear his business offer.

episodesList.title: Kunal Arrives to Stop Bhoomika's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Kunal races to stop Bhoomika’s wedding, but Supriya intervenes. Veer’s sudden arrival stuns his family as Devika digs for proof, while Gajendra grows tense on hearing about Aditya from Isha and Akhil.

episodesList.title: Veer Assumes Radhika Is Niya’s Mother
episodesList.summary: Veer dreams of marrying Radhika as Bhoomika and Raj wed. Radhika clashes with Isha over Niya’s care. Veer’s hopes fade when he assumes Radhika is Niya’s mother, while Devika plots ahead.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika’s Tearful Vidaai
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika’s vidaai takes place, and Raj solely welcomes her into his palatial house. Radhika reassures Lakshmi and Shriniwas, who are upset at Bhoomika’s departure, while Veer reels from heartbreak.

episodesList.title: Raj's Behaviour Shocks Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Veer is amazed when Devika reveals that Radhika is not married, while Raj’s behaviour on their wedding night leaves Bhoomika shocked. At the same time, Supriya hides Kunal’s heartbreak from Vijendra.

episodesList.title: Veer Visits Aishwarya's in-Laws to Meet Radhika
episodesList.summary: After meeting Gajendra, Isha runs into Devika and introduces Akhil to her. Veer avoids Akhil and later visits Aishwarya’s in‑laws with handmade sweets to see Radhika, but Niya fails to see him again.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Nivas - March 14, 2026
episodesList.summary: Born into wealth, Lakshmi chooses love over privilege and leads a life of sacrifice with Shriniwas. Years later, the couple still pursues a home of their own and their daughter’s perfect wedding.

episodesList.title: Veer's Arrival Upsets Radhika
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika's calls anger Raj, who tries to control her with the CCTV. Meanwhile, Kunal harms himself, alarming Virendra. Later, Champa misreads Raju’s help, and Veer's visit home upsets Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj's Actions Hurt Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika’s family misses her, while Raj’s anger leaves her hurt and in tears before they reconcile. Meanwhile, Radhika struggles with the money for Niya’s treatment and makes a difficult choice.

episodesList.title: Veer Learns a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Raj surprises Bhoomika with a candlelight dinner but later grows restless to see her call someone. Veer secretly helps Radhika get a higher salary and soon learns that Niya is Radhika's daughter.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Bold Advice to Veer
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas scolds Vivek and Varun for mocking Radhika’s new job. Radhika then helps Veer dodge a suitress. Raj’s dinner with Bhoomika turns chaotic due to a goon clash that Kunal unexpectedly sees.

episodesList.title: Veer Lands in Trouble Again
episodesList.summary: Vivek hides his loan application, but Varun and Aishwarya’s arrival scares him. Raj has a few goons killed and lies to Bhoomika. Veer is forced to meet a suitress but later gets scolded by Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj Stays With Bhoomika at Her Parents' House
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas faces humiliation when he urges Shankar's son to return his money. A jealous Raj stays with Bhoomika at her parents’ home for 'Pagfera', while Veer fakes injuries and visits Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj Fears His Dark Past With Raju
episodesList.summary: Radhika, guilty over Veer, turns to Bhoomika for advice as Raj’s buried past with Raju returns. His jealousy overrides his fear of exposure, and a desperate chase ends with Raju being struck.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Pursuit and Radhika’s Reluctant Steps
episodesList.summary: Raj hides his jealousy when Raju’s gesture makes Bhoomika emotional. Meanwhile, Veer fakes injury to spend time with Radhika at the hospital, and later Isha and Akhil visit her for a legal issue.

episodesList.title: Veer Stands Strong Against Akhil
episodesList.summary: Radhika signs the papers brought by Akhil and Isha, but Vivek tears them in fear of losing Aditya’s wealth. Veer arrives and threatens Akhil, while Raj secretly plants cameras at home.

episodesList.title: Akhil and Gajendra’s Secret Deal
episodesList.summary: Gajendra offers Akhil a deal to keep a secret, while Shriniwas gets bad news. A police confrontation brings Veer and Radhika closer, and Raj is stunned by Radhika’s message about visiting Bhoomika.

episodesList.title: Raj Tries to Isolate Bhoomika From Her Family
episodesList.summary: Denied entry by Raj’s guard, Radhika and Veer fail to meet Bhoomika. Raj then deceives her family to mask his plot to isolate Bhoomika and pays their electricity bill to burden them with obligation.

episodesList.title: Radhika Strikes Back at Veer’s Lies
episodesList.summary: Raj fumes when Raju’s gift delights Bhoomika, while Vijendra uncovers a hospitalised Kunal’s drinking. Champa saves Raju, Lakshmi hears of Shriniwas’s budget woes, and Radhika slaps Veer for his lies.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces an Unlikely Superior
episodesList.summary: Vivek and Varun secure their loans with Raj and Gajendra’s help. Shriniwas finds himself reporting to an unexpected boss. Lakshmi checks in with Supriya, while Veer fails to win Radhika’s forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Harish’s Plot Deepens Veer and Radhika’s Rift
episodesList.summary: Radhika stays angry with Veer despite his apologies, fuelled further by Harish’s ploy. Raj’s jealousy harms Sunny and worries Bhoomika, while Veer searches for Radhika at Varun’s store launch.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Revelation at Varun's Store Launch
episodesList.summary: At Varun’s store launch, Radhika makes a revelation that stuns Veer. Raj arrives upset after seeing something shocking at the college, while Gajendra’s taunt hurts Varun but Aishwarya lifts him.

episodesList.title: Veer Helps Radhika Stand Up to Harish
episodesList.summary: Raj terrorises Bhoomika by forcing her to erase a message carved on a classroom desk. Veer exposes Harish’s harassment of Radhika, and she later apologises to Veer as Lakshmi fears a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Broken by his boss’ harsh scolding, Shriniwas meets with a tragic accident. A stunned Bhoomika rushes him to the hospital, and Lakshmi is shocked on learning about the devastating news.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas’s Recovery Rekindles Hope
episodesList.summary: Veer saves Niya from an abduction, earning praise from the Jaiswals as Shriniwas recovers. Revati later criticises Vivek for being detached, while the family waits for Shriniwas to wake.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces Fraud Accusations
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Raj hurts himself and then leaves with Bhoomika. Radhika confides in Veer but snaps when he calls Niya his daughter. Soon, officials accuse Shriniwas of fraud, worrying Lakshmi.

episodesList.title: Veer and Radhika Sneak Into Shriniwas's Office
episodesList.summary: Upset after Vivek and Varun stay home, Lakshmi remains by Shriniwas's side at hospital with Radhika. With her consent, Veer and Radhika sneak into his office as Raj locks Bhoomika in a room at home.

episodesList.title: Joy Turns to Shock for the Jaiswals
episodesList.summary: Radhika thanks Veer for evidence to save Shriniwas, but celebrations turn grim as the police arrest him after he returns home. Elsewhere, Raj manipulates Bhoomika, while Akhil and Isha visit Gajendra.

episodesList.title: Veer Helps Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Veer secretly bails out Shriniwas from jail. Feeling grateful, Shriniwas agrees to hide the truth from the family. Elsewhere, Vivek feels worried about being exposed.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Faces an Uncertain Future
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas panics after learning that he will retire in a month. Veer ignores Radhika to lure her back, but her cold response shatters him, while Raj fumes after seeing Bhoomika’s chat with Kunal.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Punishment and a Hidden Match
episodesList.summary: Raj punishes Bhoomika for singing at a party and later questions her friend Mukesh about her college circle. Devika tricks Veer into a temple meet, while an injured Shriniwas faces taunts at work.

episodesList.title: Veer Is Cornered Into a Wedding Decision
episodesList.summary: Raj confines Bhoomika at home while secretly probing her past. Veer is shocked when Nalini’s meeting seals his marriage to Mahi, as Radhika stands up to Meenakshi’s demand for Shriniwas’ money.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Flees From Her House
episodesList.summary: Mahi and her family visits the Chouhans to discuss her match with Veer. While a frustrated Bhoomika flees through a window, Meenakshi visits her home and later informs the Jaiswals about her escape.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika on the Run
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika flees Raj's home. Kunal narrowly misses her after crossing paths with Raj at a park. Devika hires Radhika as a ruse to bring her closer to Veer, as Bhoomika’s family sets out to find her.

episodesList.title: Bhoomika Covers for Raj’s Secret
episodesList.summary: Bhoomika shields Raj as her family checks on her at his mansion. Vivek scolds Radhika for coming home late, but she shuts him down, as Veer agrees to meet Mahi to confess his love for Radhika.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Hunt Through Bhoomika’s Phone
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas hides his retirement while Raj uses Bhoomika’s phone to reach Kunal after she tries to message him. Unaware of this, Kunal goes to pick up Tanu as Radhika heads to Veer’s house for work.

episodesList.title: A Deadly Case of Mistaken Identity
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi visits Shriniwas’s office, unaware it is his retirement day. Raj kills Vinod, mistaking him for Kunal, and lets Meenakshi flee. Later, Veer and Mahi’s 'roka' is finalised against their wishes.

episodesList.title: Vinod’s Survival Sparks Deadly Fear
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas hides his job loss, while Veer learns of Radhika’s birthday from Niya. Raj returns home after killing Vinod, leaving Bhoomika uneasy. Panic strikes when Vinod is found alive.

episodesList.title: Raj Worries About Being Exposed
episodesList.summary: Veer punishes a careless driver for injuring an elderly woman. At the hospital, Raj and Bhoomika meet Vinod as the police question him, leaving Raj anxious about being exposed.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas and Varun’s Hidden Truths
episodesList.summary: Veer’s family prepares for the pre‑wedding ritual. Meanwhile, Revati and Aishwarya argue over chores. Varun and Shriniwas hide secrets, while Raj is stunned by Bhoomika’s family visit.

episodesList.title: Veer and Mahi's Pre-Wedding Ritual Gets Disrupted
episodesList.summary: Raj’s behaviour with Bhoomika sparks Lakshmi’s doubts. Veer and Mahi’s pre-wedding ritual is disrupted while Radhika’s arrival lifts his spirits. Later, Niya suggests Veer an idea.

episodesList.title: Veer's Picnic Plans and Lakshmi's Rising Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Radhika promises to fulfil Niya’s wish but hesitates when asked about a picnic with Veer. As Radhika struggles at work, Veer steps up, while Raj’s behaviour towards Bhoomika raises Lakshmi's concern.

episodesList.title: Hidden Clues Point Towards Raj
episodesList.summary: Janaki and Lakshmi worry for Bhoomika and begin observing her and Raj closely. Meanwhile, Kunal reviews CCTV footage linking Raj’s car to Vinod’s attack, as Varun plans to steal Vivek’s money.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Kindness Stuns Veer
episodesList.summary: Raj masks his possessiveness around Bhoomika’s family, only to reveal his dark side later, leaving her scared. Veer is moved by Radhika’s gesture. Later, Vijendra hands Kunal and Tanu a task.

episodesList.title: Shriniwas Helps an Auto Driver
episodesList.summary: Varun feels worried about being exposed. Shriniwas seeks help to find a new job and later rushes an ailing auto driver to the hospital, while Bhoomika grows irritated with Raj’s possessive nature.

episodesList.title: A Theft Amidst Birthday Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Varun steals Vivek’s money to repay part of his debt, while Radhika’s birthday fills her day with joy. Elsewhere, Tanu hurts Kunal unknowingly, and Champa fiercely protects Raju from goons.

episodesList.title: Veer's Outing With Radhika and Niya
episodesList.summary: Suresh brings Shriniwas to Gajendra for help, but Lakshmi too arrives there. Veer’s surprise outing with Radhika turns tense when Niya disappears, while Vivek panics as his hidden cash goes missing.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Nivas - April 26, 2026
episodesList.summary: Born into wealth, Lakshmi chooses love over privilege and leads a life of sacrifice with Shriniwas. Years later, the couple still pursues a home of their own and their daughter’s perfect wedding.

episodesList.title: Vivek’s Suspicion Sparks Chaos and Secrets
episodesList.summary: Shriniwas starts anew as an autorickshaw driver but fears when Kailash spots him. Vivek suspects and attacks Raju, then steals from Meenakshi. Raj’s surprise and Bhoomika’s call please Radhika.

episodesList.title: Vijendra Insults Shriniwas
episodesList.summary: Veer is surprised by Radhika’s gratitude for a perfect day. Shriniwas drops Supriya home in a rickshaw but faces Vijendra’s insults. Lakshmi scolds Varun after catching his cricket betting ticket.

episodesList.title: Akhil Catches Veer With Radhika and Niya
episodesList.summary: Varun apologises to Lakshmi but faces a moneylender’s humiliation. Gajendra and Akhil spot Veer with Radhika and Niya. Vivek’s accusation shocks the family, later hurting Revati with his demand.

episodesList.title: Raj’s Deadly Challenge for Bhoomika
episodesList.summary: Raj forces Bhoomika into a dangerous late-night game. Elsewhere, Vijendra explains to Supriya why he insulted Shriniwas. The next day, Veer learns Radhika’s money for Niya's admission is missing.

episodesList.title: Radhika Shaken by the Engagement Twist
episodesList.summary: Mahi and Veer’s engagement news stuns Radhika, while Vivek stirs trouble. Devika plots to pair Radhika with Veer, as Isha fakes support. Elsewhere, Kunal approaches Raj with a business proposal.

episodesList.title: Veer's Engagement Day Sparks Fresh Tension
episodesList.summary: Everyone gathers for Veer and Mahi’s engagement as Radhika drops Niya on her first day of school. Isha plans to stop Radhika from attending the event. Later, Kunal scolds Tanu over Raj’s office visit.

episodesList.title: Devika Plots to Delay Veer’s Engagement
episodesList.summary: Veer and Mahi are left stunned as their families force an engagement. Devika schemes to delay it until Radhika arrives. As Isha abducts Niya to stop Radhika from attending, Raj steps in to help.

episodesList.title: Veer Is Forced Into a Reluctant Engagement
episodesList.summary: Veer feels unsettled at his engagement to Mahi, his heart still with Radhika. While Devika subtly supports him, Isha plots in secret. Veer injures himself to stop it but is forced to exchange rings.

episodesList.title: Veer’s Grandmother Insults the Jaiswals
episodesList.summary: Veer goes to Mahi to call off the engagement. As his grandmother humiliates the Jaiswals over the missing coin, Revati steps in with the truth. Later, Veer’s next move stuns his family.

title: Honeymoon Se Hatya
summary: Honeymoon Se Hatya (transl. hi – transl. Murder from the Honeymoon) is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language true crime documentary series directed by Ajitesh Sharma. Produced by Aditya Pittie and Samar Khan, the series premiered on ZEE5 on 9 January 2026. The docuseries explores high-profile criminal cases in India where wives were accused of murdering their husbands, examining the psychological, social, and emotional factors behind the crimes.
plot: The series is a six-part docudrama that investigates the motivations behind domestic homicides. Rather than focusing solely on the forensic details, it delves into the "silent battles" within marriages, including themes of control, suppression, and emotional trauma. Each episode utilizes factual narration, archival footage, and dramatic recreations, alongside interviews with investigators and journalists.
reception:
The series received mixed reviews from critics. OTTplay rated it 3/5 and wrote that the series' raw, fact-led treatment and the inclusion of interviews with families and police officers add emotional weight, though its promised psychological analysis remains underdeveloped.
Writing for The Times of India, Archika Khurana rated the first season 3/5, describing it as authentic and well-researched with visual realism, but said the execution is uneven and falls short of a truly penetrating psychological study.
In Aaj Tak, Shikhar Negi rated the series 2/5, noting that it largely revisits cases that were extensively covered in the news and offers few new revelations, while also arguing that its attempt to explain motives through psychological framing feels incomplete.
TheJBT similarly wrote that while the subject matter and choice of cases are compelling, the series is less effective at offering fresh insights and does not fully answer its central question about why the crimes occurred.

articleSections.title: Featured cases
articleSections.text: The series covers five major real-life cases that captured national media attention in India: * The Meerut Blue Drum Case: Based on the murder of Saurabh Rajput, whose body was found dismembered and hidden in a cement-filled blue drum in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. * The Meghalaya Honeymoon Murder: Follows the disappearance and murder of Raja Raghuvanshi during his honeymoon. * The Mumbai Tile Case: Investigates a case in Nalasopara where a body was concealed behind wall tiles.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced in January 2026 as part of ZEE5's expansion into the true crime genre. It was written by Satyen Bordoloi.

articleSections.title: Release

episodesList.title: Meerut - Blue Drum Case
episodesList.summary: Meerut's Saurabh Rajput has his life cut short by his wife, Muskan, and her lover, Sahil. The two poisoned him and hid his cut-up body in a drum of cement. The details of the crime shocked the nation.

plotHtml: The series is a six-part docudrama that investigates the motivations behind domestic homicides. Rather than focusing solely on the forensic details, it delves into the "silent battles" within marriages, including themes of control, suppression, and emotional trauma. Each episode utilizes factual narration, archival footage, and dramatic recreations, alongside interviews with investigators and journalists.

title: Mahadev & Sons
summary: Mahadev & Sons is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that aired on 5 January 2026 on Colors TV and digitally available on JioHotstar. Produced by Saurabh Tewari under Parin Multimedia, it stars Shakti Anand, Sneha Wagh and Manasi Salvi. The series is an official adaptation of Star Vijay's Tamil series Pandian Stores 2.
plot:
Mahadev, an orphan, works as a servant in the house of the Bajpai family, the owners of Bajpai Brick Kiln. Their elder daughter, Bhanu is deeply attached to her younger sister, Vidya.
10 years later, he elopes with Vidya. After some time, Bhanu's wedding is fixed to a man named Madhav, who angers her by talking about Vidya and Mahadev. Later, she swears that she will never get married until she sees Mahadev's funeral. Due to this, their father, Omprakash Bajpai goes in a dilemma and dies.
25 years later, Vidya and Mahadev live in a wealthy family, and have 5 children: Ashish, Kamakshi, Ketan, Dheeraj, and Priya. Bhanu prays for Mahadev's demise wih her brother Yash, while their youngest son, Dheeraj, wants his family to celebrate their 25th anniversary, and brings a poster along with his uncle, Satya. Seeing this, Mahadev gets angered and throws the poster, which lands at Bhanu's house and destroys her cake. Because of this, they both fight outside their houses, and Mahadev decides to celebrate their 25th anniversary. Bhanu tells the people coming to their anniversary to eat her birthday cake first. Mahadev is heartbroken when no one comes to his celebration.
Later, Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev's rice mill to get a gift for his girlfriend, Narmada, which Dheeraj is blamed for. Ashish is also heartbroken after he sees his girlfriend Madhu married to someone else, which makes Ashish get himself drunk. Mahadev is shocked to see this, and he soon asks a priest to find brides for their 3 sons. Dheeraj later ensures Ketan that he will be married to Narmada. Ashish comes home drunk once more, which makes his dad angry, and as a result of this Ashish is beaten up. Dheeraj goes to Narmada's house, and talks to her father, Ramesh Saini. He later tells Mahadev about Ketan, who also gets beaten up. Mahadev later tells that no one in the house will have a love marriage. Due to this, Ketan tells Narmada to move on and forget him, which shatters her. Later, Narmada comes to their house, and they later plan to elope and marry. Dheeraj assures his brother's marriage.
The next day, they both go to the temple to marry each other, which Bhanu and her foster daughter Rajji see, who call Mahadev asking for help with rice bags. Mahadev and Vidya come and are shocked to see their marriage. Bhanu provokes Mahadev, while Dheeraj tells Ketan to stay strong. After they find out Dheeraj was behind the marriage, Mahadev ruthlessly kicks Dheeraj out of the house. He later spends the night alone on a bench.
Narmada later tells Rajji to help her in finding Dheeraj. Bhanu later lies to Mahadev that Vidya is secretly betraying him, who asks her to choose between him or Dheeraj. Yash and Ramesh secretly plot against Dheeraj, and send goons to stab Dheeraj.Their plan succeeds and Dheeraj is sent to the hospital.Vidya warns Mahadev that she would never forgive him if something happens to Dheeraj and Mahadev eventually realises his mistakes. He asks Dheeraj for forgiveness and the family reunites. Mahadev, being certain that Yash and Bhanu had some hand in Dheeraj's planned attack, files FIR against them. Bhanu proves Yash and herself innocent while proving Ramesh responsible for the entire attack leading to his arrest. This causes friction between Narmada and the family with Vidya saying she would never become a family member odlf their house, while Dheeraj promises he would give Narmada her rightful place in the family.
Elsewhere, Rajji is in love with Kalyan, a fraudster and criminal who is playing love game with her with the evil intention of selling her to some goons. Even after warnings from Dheeraj, she keeps believing in Kalyan. One day Dheeraj overheard Kalyan promising the goons to deliver Rajji to them by the college fest. He tries to tell Rajji the truth but she misunderstands that he is intentionally trying to create friction between the two. Helpless Dheeraj tells about Rajji's love affair to his grandmother and Bhanu warning them about Kalyan's plan to sell Rajji

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: In November 2025, Colors TV unveiled a teaser introducing the new show titled Mahadev & Sons.

articleSections.title: Casting

episodesList.title: The Journey of Mahadev, Vidya
episodesList.summary: Once inseparable sisters, Bhanu and Vidya are torn apart when Vidya marries Mahadev. Will Vidya and Mahadev stay united and overcome the challenges ahead?

episodesList.title: Bhanu Draws the Battle Line
episodesList.summary: Twenty-five years later, Bhanu performs a pooja, praying for Mahadev's downfall. Later, she openly challenges Mahadev to see whose celebration draws a bigger crowd.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Grand Announcement
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj openly mocks the challenge and announces a lavish anniversary celebration. Later Mahadev and Bhanu's families unexpectedly come face to face at the same temple.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Empty Celebration
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Bhanu's families pray together before exchanging taunts about future separations. Later, Mahadev emotionally reveals he's an orphan as no guests attend his anniversary.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Fears Family Divide
episodesList.summary: Mahadev lashes out at Bhanu for serving meat and alcohol at her home. Later, Mahadev shares his fear with Vidya about a daughter-in-law breaking the family apart.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Blamed For Ketan's Crime
episodesList.summary: Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev to buy a gift for Narmada. Later, Mahadev wrongly accuses Dheeraj of theft, leaving him devastated as he chooses to hide Ketan's truth.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Confronts Mahadev's Family
episodesList.summary: Mahadev explains to Vidya why he is strict with his sons to make them strong. Later, Bhanu enters Mahadev's house aggressively with her family and Rajji, reopening old tensions.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Misunderstood Truth
episodesList.summary: Mahadev beats Dheeraj after Rajji reveals the truth of the letter, Dheeraj vows to marry per his wishes. Later, Bhanu confronts Rajji while Radha predicts romance ahead.

episodesList.title: Satya Confronts Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Satya questions Mahadev why he didn't let their sons marry by choice despite his love marriage with Vidya. Later, Bhanu asks Rajji why she stayed calm when Ashish teased her.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Defends Priya
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj urges Ketan to tell Mahadev about his relationship with Narmada, while Radha reminisces about her childhood with Vidya. Later, Bhanu fights off the goons harassing Priya.

episodesList.title: Narmada Faces Alliance Trouble
episodesList.summary: Narmada grows anxious as her parents discuss her marriage alliance. Later, Ketan boldly proposes a clever plan to help Narmada send the prospective suitors away.

episodesList.title: Ashish Endures Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Narmada firmly instructs Ketan to discuss their marriage with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Ashish feels heartbroken seeing Madhu married and gets drunk, while Bhanu spies on him.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Plots Her Revenge
episodesList.summary: Tension heightens at home when Mahadev and Vidya find Ashish drunk. Later, Mahadev winces in pain as he recalls Bhanu's words, while she plots to destroy his sons.

episodesList.title: Vidya Learns Ashish's Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Rajji firmly confirms to Dheeraj that she hasn't shared Ashish's video with anyone but him. Later, Dheeraj reveals to Vidya that Ashish sacrificed his love for Mahadev's respect.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Move Stuns His Sons
episodesList.summary: Ketan, Dheeraj and Ashish are stunned when Mahadev asks Panditji to find brides for them. Later, Dheeraj promises Narmada he will ensure her wedding with Ketan happens.

episodesList.title: Ashish Faces Mahadev's Wrath
episodesList.summary: As Mahadev slaps Ashish for returning home drunk yet again, Dheeraj spins a false story to cover it up. Elsewhere, Bhanu urges Rajji to keep a close watch on Dheeraj secretly.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Blocks The Alliance
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj tells Mr. Saini about Narmada and Ketan's love and urges him to speak to Mahadev about them. Later, Bhanu warns Mr Saini against arranging Narmada's alliance with Ketan.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Firm Guidance
episodesList.summary: Mr. Saini insults Mahadev, claiming Ketan trapped Narmada. Later, Mahadev urges his children to follow his guidance, while Vidya asks Ketan to forget Narmada.

episodesList.title: Ketan's Words Break Narmada
episodesList.summary: At night, Mahadev helps Rajji when her scooty breaks down on the road. Meanwhile, Ketan gently asks Narmada to move on and forget him, leaving her shattered.

episodesList.title: Narmada, Ketan's Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Ketan and Narmada plan to elope and marry. Later, as Ketan and Dheeraj attempt to flee to meet Narmada, Mahadev intervenes.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Bhanu arrives at the temple to find Dheeraj helping Ketan and Narmada marry. Later, Rajji calls Mahadev to the temple by asking for help with rice bags to expose the truth.

episodesList.title: Ketan and Narmada's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Narmada feels remorse for betraying her parents and marrying without their consent. Later, Ketan completes the ritual as Mahadev and Vidya are shocked to witness the marriage.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Stands By Ketan
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj urges Ketan to stay strong and face Mahadev, reminding him of Narmada's support. Later, Bhanu's family grandly welcomes Ketan and Narmada, provoking Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Ruthless Authority
episodesList.summary: Mahadev forcefully throws Dheeraj out after a bitter clash and disowns him. Watching this, Bhanu foresees the inevitable downfall of Mahadev's entire family.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Night Of Despair
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj spends the night alone on a bench, hoping Mahadev will call him home. Meanwhile, Bhanu secretly plots to disturb Mahadev's family peace.

episodesList.title: Narmada Seeks Shelter
episodesList.summary: Narmada hopes for acceptance as Mahadev gives her refuge. Later, he protects her from Ramesh's rage, deepening the family conflict.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Support For Narmada
episodesList.summary: Mahadev stands up for Narmada when Kamakshi tries to humiliate her. Later, Vidya is lost in thoughts about Dheeraj as the family gathers for the morning Aarti.

episodesList.title: Narmada Turns to Rajji For Help
episodesList.summary: Narmada seeks Rajji's help in finding Dheeraj and bringing him back home. Later, Bhanu watches Narmada's efforts for the family and vows to tear them apart.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Ultimatum to Vidya
episodesList.summary: Bhanu provokes Mahadev's anger by claiming that Vidya is betraying him. Later, Mahadev confronts Vidya and gives her an ultimatum to choose between him and Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Yash, Ramesh's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Yash and Ramesh plot against Dheeraj by sending goons who attack and stab him. Tensions rise as Mahadev and the family learn of the attack and rush to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahadev saves Dheeraj with his blood and apologises as he recovers. Later, Dheeraj reminds him of his expulsion, while Mahadev moves to track down the attackers.

episodesList.title: Ketan and Vishwa's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: Ketan and Vishwa fight over Narmada crossing the line, while Bhanu urges Vishwa to apologise. Later, Dheeraj tells Narmada about Mahadev's struggles after marrying Vidya.

episodesList.title: Narmada Assists Vidya
episodesList.summary: Narmada feels grateful to Vidya and Mahadev for being gracious in-laws. Later, Narmada helps Vidya in convincing Mahadev to perform the Rudra Abhishek Puja.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Against Mahadev
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Bhanu and Yash over Mahadev's complaint for attacking Dheeraj. Later, Bhanu provokes Rajji, who confronts Mahadev over the allegations against Bhanu.

episodesList.title: Mahadev, Vidya's Valentine Vibes
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Vidya join the family to dance and celebrate Valentine's Day with joy and fun. Later, Vidya consoles an upset Narmada as her parents ignore her calls.

episodesList.title: Saini's Dark Secret
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and the family celebrate Maha Shivratri. Later, they are shocked as the police bring Mr. Saini, revealing that he was behind the attack on Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Promise to Narmada
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj vows to restore Narmada's rightful respect and reunite her with the family. Later, Narmada strives to win back her family's acceptance.

episodesList.title: Kalyan's Evil Plot Against Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj overhears Kalyan plotting to traffic Rajji. Later, Narmada's mother arrives at Mahadev's house seeking help for Mr. Saini, but suddenly suffers from seizures.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Brave Confession
episodesList.summary: Kamakshi accuses and insults Narmada's mother of robbery. Later, following Narmada's advice, Dheeraj confides in Radha about Kalyan's plot against Rajji.

episodesList.title: Rajji in Danger?
episodesList.summary: Ketan insists Narmada seek Mahadev's permission before rejoining the job. Later, at the party, Kalyan tampers with Rajji's drink and tries to abduct her, but Dheeraj follows him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Rescues Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj saves Rajji from Kalyan's abduction attempt. Later, Vidya calls Bhanu to assure her that Rajji is safe and will stay with her for the night.

episodesList.title: Rajji Faces Bhanu's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj struggles to manage an intoxicated Rajji. Later, a furious Bhanu lashes out at Rajji over her bond with Kalyan and prevents her from attending college.

episodesList.title: Rajji Faces Alliance Trouble
episodesList.summary: As an alliance suitor arrives to see Rajji, Kalyan boldly confesses his love for Rajji before everyone. Meanwhile, Narmada seeks permission from Mahadev to take a job.

episodesList.title: Holi Happiness at Mahadev's Home
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Vidya feel happy seeing Ketan play Holi after years. As the festivities begin, a lively Antakshari competition kicks off between Mahadev and Bhanu's families.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Accusation Causes a Rift
episodesList.summary: Rajji falsely accuses Dheeraj of forcefully applying colour on her, sparking a clash. Later, Bhanu feels happy when Rajji elopes with Kalyan, making her plan succeed.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Walks Into a Trap
episodesList.summary: Bhanu alerts the police about illegal activity at a hotel as Dheeraj and Vidya search for Rajji. Later, a raid finds Dheeraj with a disoriented Rajji, sparking a misunderstanding.

episodesList.title: Rajji, Dheeraj Get Married
episodesList.summary: At Vidya's request, Dheeraj and Rajji tie the knot at a temple. Later, Dheeraj insists on keeping Vidya's role in his marriage with Rajji a secret from Mahadev.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and the family are left stunned to learn that Dheeraj and Rajji are married. Later, Vidya decides to tell Mahadev the truth, but Narmada reminds her of the vow to Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya's Inner Conflict
episodesList.summary: Vidya scolds Ketan and Kamakshi for eavesdropping on Dheeraj and Rajji. Later, she expresses her guilt to Dheeraj for hiding the truth and letting him take the blame.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Questions Vidya's Parenting
episodesList.summary: Mahadev fumes at Vidya for siding with Dheeraj, who repeatedly risks the family's honour. Later, Dheeraj confronts Vidya for forcing him to marry Rajji to protect Bhanu's respect.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Manipulates Rajji
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj confronts Rajji for trying to slip out of the house secretly. Bhanu then emotionally blackmails Rajji to stay at Mahadev's house and take revenge on him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Suspects Rajji's Intents
episodesList.summary: Dheeraj shares his suspicions with Vidya about Rajji's intentions after meeting Bhanu. Soon after, he feels nervous about his wedding night with Rajji.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Regrets Dheeraj's Actions
episodesList.summary: Rajji tells Mahadev her marriage to Dheeraj was her own wish, while Mahadev regrets Dheeraj's disobedience. Rajji recalls memories with Bhanu as Vidya selects a saree for her.

episodesList.title: Vidya Stands Up for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji takes the money Mahadev entrusted to Vidya, sparking suspicion. As Mahadev accuses Dheeraj of stealing from the mill locker, Vidya firmly defends him.

episodesList.title: Vishwa's Deadly Plot
episodesList.summary: Narmada confronts Ketan for buying gifts with stolen money and later comforts Rajji with festival memories. Meanwhile, Vishwa secretly schemes to kill Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya's Belief in Rajji
episodesList.summary: Mahadev announces the names for puja blessings, deliberately omitting Dheeraj and Rajji. Vidya expresses faith that Rajji will bring happiness to their family.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Eases Ashish's Pain
episodesList.summary: A game of tug of war turns emotional as Vidya and Bhanu relive their treasured memories. Elsewhere, Dheeraj consoles Ashish as he breaks down after seeing Madhu.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Outburst at Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and his sons win the Best Parivaar award, but before the ceremony, Bhanu humiliates Mahadev and Rajji. Vidya comforts Rajji, who is upset by Bhanu's words.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Fearless for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji bravely stops Vishwa from stabbing Dheeraj, but Vishwa shoots him instead. While Vidya worries about Dheeraj, Rajji rushes a wounded Dheeraj to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Vidya Fumes at Vishwa
episodesList.summary: Ketan reveals to Vidya that Vishwa tried to kill Dheeraj and shot him. Vishwa faces Vidya's wrath, and Bhanu confides in Vidya that she was unaware of Vishwa's attack on Dheeraj.

episodesList.title: Vidya Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Mahadev's cold detachment after Dheeraj's betrayal makes him distant from the family. Vidya tearfully apologises to Dheeraj, blaming herself for his forced marriage to Rajji.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Silent Care for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Rajji watches Mahadev, secretly showing deep concern for Dheeraj. Then, Mahadev angrily confronts Vishwa for attacking Dheeraj and sternly warns Yash to control Vishwa.

episodesList.title: Narmada's Matchmaking Plan
episodesList.summary: Bhanu reveals the truth about Ashish and his girlfriend to Mahadev. Narmada and Vidya try to unite Dheeraj and Rajji, but Dheeraj calls out Rajji for faking concern.

episodesList.title: Kalyan Breaks Rajji's Heart
episodesList.summary: Rajji is heartbroken after discovering Kalyan used her for money. Dheeraj comforts her as she struggles to cope with the pain of Kalyan's betrayal.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Sparks Family Tension
episodesList.summary: Vidya is stunned to see Rajji and Dheeraj together and explains the significance of the Mangalsutra. Bhanu exposes and insults Mahadev, warning Arpita's father about the relation.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Accuses Dheeraj of Theft
episodesList.summary: Mahadev holds Dheeraj and Ketan responsible for Ashish's broken alliance. Rajji informs Bhanu of Kalyan's jewellery theft, but Bhanu plots to frame Dheeraj for stealing it.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Bhanu accuses Dheeraj of stealing jewellery from her house, and he accepts his crime, hiding the truth from Mahadev. Later, Bhanu gets Mahadev arrested from his mill.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Plea to Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Mahadev accepts the accusations and feels guilty for not raising Dheeraj well. Bhanu refuses Rajji's request to withdraw the false complaint against Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Bhanu's Bold Ultimatum to Rajji
episodesList.summary: Rajji urges Bhanu to revoke the FIR against Mahadev. Bhanu stuns everyone by demanding that she will retract it only if Rajji and Dheeraj break their marriage.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Faces Tough Questions
episodesList.summary: Mahadev feels heartbroken by the humiliation and holds Dheeraj and Rajji responsible for it. Dheeraj struggles to answer as Ketan and Ashish press him about the missing jewellery.

episodesList.title: Rajji Confesses Her Guilt to Vidya
episodesList.summary: Rajji expresses guilt and regret to Vidya, revealing that she went out to search for Kalyan. Soon, Mahadev shares with Vidya about taking Ashish to the Swayamvar.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Caught in Kalyan's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Mogra and her mother spring into action when goons tease her. With no other option, Rajji strikes Dheeraj on the head, rendering him unconscious as part of Kalyan's plan.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj, Rajji Shield Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mogra and Ashish's alliance is finalised. The police arrive to arrest Mahadev for failing to produce Bhanu's jewellery, but Dheeraj and Rajji arrive in time and save him.

episodesList.title: Rajji Wins Vidya's Heart
episodesList.summary: Seeing the family happy, Vidya thanks Rajji for protecting Mahadev's reputation. Soon after, Rajji joins Narmada to uncover the truth about Mogra's family.

episodesList.title: Lajwanti's Trap Seals Ashish's Fate
episodesList.summary: Lajwanti manipulates every move, pushing Mahadev to fix Ashish's wedding with Mogra. While the family celebrates, Rajji and Narmada secretly decide to uncover the truth.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj's Apology to Narmada
episodesList.summary: Mogra and her family grow fearful seeing Sikander at their house. Rajji makes Dheeraj realise his mistake, and he apologises to Narmada for hurting her feelings.

episodesList.title: Sikander Kidnaps Narmada
episodesList.summary: Narmada's search for answers takes a dark turn when she encounters Sikander at Mogra's house and is kidnapped. Yash and Kiran are exposed when Mahadev recognises them.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Faces Shocking Kidnap Call
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise in the family as Mahadev accuses Bhanu of kidnapping Narmada. Mahadev receives a call from Sikander, who blackmails him and demands ten lakhs for Narmada's release.

episodesList.title: Narmada's Brave Act
episodesList.summary: Mahadev fails to rescue Narmada as the kidnappers escape. Narmada fights the kidnappers fiercely as Dheeraj and Rajji overpower them, freeing her.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Faces a Harsh Reality
episodesList.summary: Narmada returns home, unaware that Mogra and Sikander are plotting something dangerous. Trying to take responsibility, Dheeraj faces a crushing setback when he doesn't get a job.

episodesList.title: Rajji's Job Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Lajwanti trains Mogra on how to talk with Ashish and keep him under control. Tensions rise as Bhanu storms into Mahadev's house, accusing him of making Rajji work as a waiter.

episodesList.title: Maddy Enters the House
episodesList.summary: Mahadev supports Narmada's wish to work, leaving her emotional. Meanwhile, Radha urges Bhanu to treat Maddy with warmth as a valued guest.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Plots to Ruin the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Narmada grows suspicious of Mogra as Mahadev fixes the wedding and pushes for shared expenses. Meanwhile, Bhanu tries to sabotage the alliance.

episodesList.title: Rajji Confronts Bhanu
episodesList.summary: Mahadev apologises to Ashish for breaking his promise about the alliance with Mogra. Rajji confronts Bhanu, demanding the reason for her revenge against Mahadev's family.

episodesList.title: Ashish's Arrest Halts the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Rajji is shattered by Dheeraj's cold behaviour as Mahadev tries to fix Ashish's wedding. However, the wedding gets called off when Ashish is arrested for hitting Vishwa.

episodesList.title: Bhanu Severs Ties With Rajji
episodesList.summary: Bhanu withdraws her FIR against Ashish and breaks all ties with Rajji, leaving her heartbroken. Mogra and Lajwanti visit Mahadev's home to arrange her alliance with Ashish.

episodesList.title: Rajji Stands Up for Dheeraj
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise at Ashish and Mogra's engagement as Narmada grows suspicious over a ring. Shock spreads when Dheeraj is seen in a humiliating situation, but Rajji defends him.

episodesList.title: Dheeraj Gets Mahadev's Approval
episodesList.summary: Bhanu disrupts Ashish and Mogra's engagement by assaulting Maddy and causing chaos. Later, Mahadev allows Dheeraj to attend the wedding, warning him not to break his trust.

plotHtml:
Mahadev, an orphan, works as a servant in the house of the Bajpai family, the owners of Bajpai Brick Kiln. Their elder daughter, Bhanu is deeply attached to her younger sister, Vidya.
10 years later, he elopes with Vidya. After some time, Bhanu's wedding is fixed to a man named Madhav, who angers her by talking about Vidya and Mahadev. Later, she swears that she will never get married until she sees Mahadev's funeral. Due to this, their father, Omprakash Bajpai goes in a dilemma and dies.
25 years later, Vidya and Mahadev live in a wealthy family, and have 5 children: Ashish, Kamakshi, Ketan, Dheeraj, and Priya. Bhanu prays for Mahadev's demise wih her brother Yash, while their youngest son, Dheeraj, wants his family to celebrate their 25th anniversary, and brings a poster along with his uncle, Satya. Seeing this, Mahadev gets angered and throws the poster, which lands at Bhanu's house and destroys her cake. Because of this, they both fight outside their houses, and Mahadev decides to celebrate their 25th anniversary. Bhanu tells the people coming to their anniversary to eat her birthday cake first. Mahadev is heartbroken when no one comes to his celebration.
Later, Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev's rice mill to get a gift for his girlfriend, Narmada, which Dheeraj is blamed for. Ashish is also heartbroken after he sees his girlfriend Madhu married to someone else, which makes Ashish get himself drunk. Mahadev is shocked to see this, and he soon asks a priest to find brides for their 3 sons. Dheeraj later ensures Ketan that he will be married to Narmada. Ashish comes home drunk once more, which makes his dad angry, and as a result of this Ashish is beaten up. Dheeraj goes to Narmada's house, and talks to her father, Ramesh Saini. He later tells Mahadev about Ketan, who also gets beaten up. Mahadev later tells that no one in the house will have a love marriage. Due to this, Ketan tells Narmada to move on and forget him, which shatters her. Later, Narmada comes to their house, and they later plan to elope and marry. Dheeraj assures his brother's marriage.
The next day, they both go to the temple to marry each other, which Bhanu and her foster daughter Rajji see, who call Mahadev asking for help with rice bags. Mahadev and Vidya come and are shocked to see their marriage. Bhanu provokes Mahadev, while Dheeraj tells Ketan to stay strong. After they find out Dheeraj was behind the marriage, Mahadev ruthlessly kicks Dheeraj out of the house. He later spends the night alone on a bench.
Narmada later tells Rajji to help her in finding Dheeraj. Bhanu later lies to Mahadev that Vidya is secretly betraying him, who asks her to choose between him or Dheeraj. Yash and Ramesh secretly plot against Dheeraj, and send goons to stab Dheeraj.Their plan succeeds and Dheeraj is sent to the hospital.Vidya warns Mahadev that she would never forgive him if something happens to Dheeraj and Mahadev eventually realises his mistakes. He asks Dheeraj for forgiveness and the family reunites. Mahadev, being certain that Yash and Bhanu had some hand in Dheeraj's planned attack, files FIR against them. Bhanu proves Yash and herself innocent while proving Ramesh responsible for the entire attack leading to his arrest. This causes friction between Narmada and the family with Vidya saying she would never become a family member odlf their house, while Dheeraj promises he would give Narmada her rightful place in the family.
Elsewhere, Rajji is in love with Kalyan, a fraudster and criminal who is playing love game with her with the evil intention of selling her to some goons. Even after warnings from Dheeraj, she keeps believing in Kalyan. One day Dheeraj overheard Kalyan promising the goons to deliver Rajji to them by the college fest. He tries to tell Rajji the truth but she misunderstands that he is intentionally trying to create friction between the two. Helpless Dheeraj tells about Rajji's love affair to his grandmother and Bhanu warning them about Kalyan's plan to sell Rajji
tagline: Amidst family feuds and unfulfilled desires, Mahadev navigates love and heartbreak as he strives to celebrate a milestone anniversary.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
summary:
Suttum Vizhi Sudare - Oru Chinanjiru Kuyilin Kadhai is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language drama television series starring Vinusha Devi, Tanishka and Yuvan Mayilsamy in lead roles. Produced by K. Jayalakshmi under Venus Infotainment, the series is a remake of Star Maa's Telugu language series Chinni.
The series explores the revolving around a young girl named Sudar and her deep bond with her mother, Abinaya. It premiered on Star Vijay on 5 January 2026 and is also available on the digital platform JioHotstar.
plot:
The story is about a young woman named Abi, who was wrongfully jailed for a murder she did not commit. In jail, she learns that she is pregnant and gives birth to a daughter, Sudar. After spending ten years in prison with her mother, Sudar is taken away by an NGO worker, Radhika, to go and live with her brother, Shanmugam.
Sudar faces hostility from Sarala, Shanmugam's wife. Abinaya continues to worry about her daughter's safety and future. As the story unfolds, secrets begin to unravel about her life, both in the past and present.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Vinusha Devi as Abinaya: Shanmugam's sister; Vetri's wife; Sudar's mother * Tanishka as Sudar: Abi and Vetri's daughter * Yuvan Mayilsamy as Vetri: Abi's husband; Sudar's father

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: It is an adaptation of Star Maa's Telugu language series Chinni. The series is directed by Harish Adithya, known for his television soap operas such as Kalyana Parisu 2 (2014), Thirumagal (2020) and Thangamagal (2024–2025). The series is produced by K. Jayalakshmi under the Venus Infotainment and the music by Kiran.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Bharathi Kannamma serial fame Vinusha Devi was cast as female lead Abi, Tanishka was cast as Sudar, Yuvan Mayilsamy was cast as male lead Vetri, he had worked with Harish Adithya's series Thangamagal.
Actors Ishwar and Rajkumar were cast in important roles. Actor Fawaz was cast as private role but he left the series and was replaced by actor Vikash in March 2026.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
On 25 November 2025, the first Launch promo was released, giving a brief insight into Sudar's talk with her pregnant mother. The second promo was released on 17 December 2025, featuring Abi and Sudar's life and revealing the plot through a song. On 28 December 2025, they revealed the release date.
The show started airing on Star Vijay on 5 January 2026 on Monday to Saturday, replacing Magale En Marumagale
