title: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
summary: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language coming-of-age sports drama television series written by Aruna Rakhee, directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, and starring Vikranth, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Daffe Naveen, Gundu Karthik, Sindhu Shyam, Smruthi Mohankumar and Ayaz Khan. The series' story is based on Cricket coach Rangan and his students. The show premiered on JioHotstar on 1 January 2026 and ended with 120 episodes on 23 July 2026.
plot: This series follows a failed cricket player turned coach for the Muthu Nagar Cricket Academy team (Rangan). Rangan's journey along with students at the struggling academy, who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths, forms the main plotline.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by JioHotstar under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The platform plans to launch nine new original shows in Tamil language. This series was created as the first series of the Hotstar Specials lineup in 2026.
The series is directed by Ganesh Karthikeyan, written by Aruna Rakhee and producer by A Tele Factory, who previously produced Chinna Thambi, Eeramana Rojave 2 and Heart Beat.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Actor Vikranth play the a Cricket coach Rangan. This is his debut role in a limited series, alongside Akshatha, Daffe Naveen, Niyathi Kadambi, Harish, Sindhu Shyam and Ayaz Khan.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first trailer was released under the banner of South UnBound on 9 December 2025. The first promo was released on 17 December 2025 and revealed the releasing date. On 22 December 2025, was releasing the series song. The series was released on 1 January 2026 in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Marathi and Bengali.

episodesList.title: First Innings
episodesList.summary: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

episodesList.title: Campus Oath
episodesList.summary: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

episodesList.title: Morning Runs
episodesList.summary: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

episodesList.title: Ghost Practice
episodesList.summary: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

episodesList.title: Dream Wakeup
episodesList.summary: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

episodesList.title: Footwork and Footwear
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

episodesList.title: Hidden Torture
episodesList.summary: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

episodesList.title: Revenge Storm
episodesList.summary: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

episodesList.title: Mani’s Mission
episodesList.summary: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

episodesList.title: Pair Up Pressure
episodesList.summary: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

episodesList.title: Hidden Feelings
episodesList.summary: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

episodesList.title: Mistakes and Misfires
episodesList.summary: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

episodesList.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
episodesList.summary: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

episodesList.title: Shadows of the Past
episodesList.summary: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

episodesList.title: Rangan’s Return
episodesList.summary: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Wounds
episodesList.summary: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

episodesList.title: The Weight of the Past
episodesList.summary: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

episodesList.title: Lines of Trust
episodesList.summary: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

episodesList.title: Open Challenge
episodesList.summary: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

episodesList.title: Cracks in Between
episodesList.summary: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

episodesList.title: Inner Battle
episodesList.summary: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

episodesList.title: Unstable Ground
episodesList.summary: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

episodesList.title: Crossing the Boundary
episodesList.summary: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

episodesList.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
episodesList.summary: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

episodesList.title: Damage Control
episodesList.summary: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
episodesList.summary: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

episodesList.title: They Are My Team
episodesList.summary: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

episodesList.title: Fault Lines
episodesList.summary: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

episodesList.title: Pressure Points
episodesList.summary: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

episodesList.title: Hidden Battles
episodesList.summary: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

episodesList.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
episodesList.summary: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

episodesList.title: Shifts and Challenges
episodesList.summary: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

episodesList.title: Voices Under Noise
episodesList.summary: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

episodesList.title: Silent Drift
episodesList.summary: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

episodesList.title: One Last Chance
episodesList.summary: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

episodesList.title: Closed Gates
episodesList.summary: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Feelings
episodesList.summary: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

episodesList.title: Surface Fractures
episodesList.summary: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

episodesList.title: Shifting Bonds
episodesList.summary: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

episodesList.title: Gossip and Revelations
episodesList.summary: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

episodesList.title: Confessions
episodesList.summary: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Minds
episodesList.summary: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

episodesList.title: Choices Left Unspoken
episodesList.summary: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

episodesList.title: Terrace Party
episodesList.summary: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

episodesList.title: Viral Turn
episodesList.summary: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

episodesList.title: Rising Tensions
episodesList.summary: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

episodesList.title: Night Unravels
episodesList.summary: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

episodesList.title: Unseen War
episodesList.summary: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

episodesList.title: Silent Pressure
episodesList.summary: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

episodesList.title: Sudden Arrival
episodesList.summary: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

episodesList.title: Facing Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

episodesList.title: Tournament Heat
episodesList.summary: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

episodesList.title: Beginning of the Battle
episodesList.summary: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

episodesList.title: Fear to Fire
episodesList.summary: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

episodesList.title: Falling Apart
episodesList.summary: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

episodesList.title: Narrow Loss
episodesList.summary: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

episodesList.title: Momentum Shift
episodesList.summary: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

episodesList.title: Silent Sabotage
episodesList.summary: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

episodesList.title: Against the Odds
episodesList.summary: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

episodesList.title: Interrupted Moments
episodesList.summary: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

episodesList.title: Rukmani's Treat
episodesList.summary: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

episodesList.title: Rumours and Rivalries
episodesList.summary: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

episodesList.title: Shift in Bonds
episodesList.summary: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

episodesList.title: Awkward Beginnings
episodesList.summary: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

episodesList.title: Date Plan
episodesList.summary: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

episodesList.title: Unsteady Hearts
episodesList.summary: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

episodesList.title: Triple Date
episodesList.summary: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

episodesList.title: Love and Leverage
episodesList.summary: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

episodesList.title: Silent Battles
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

episodesList.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
episodesList.summary: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

episodesList.title: Lines Crossed
episodesList.summary: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

episodesList.title: New Year Break
episodesList.summary: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

episodesList.title: Holiday Begins
episodesList.summary: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

episodesList.title: Love Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

episodesList.title: Between Holding and Losing
episodesList.summary: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

episodesList.title: Strength and Silence
episodesList.summary: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

episodesList.title: The Counter Move
episodesList.summary: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

episodesList.title: Where Hearts Drift
episodesList.summary: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

episodesList.title: The Distance Between Us
episodesList.summary: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

episodesList.title: When Control Slips
episodesList.summary: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

episodesList.title: Cracks Deepen
episodesList.summary: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

episodesList.title: What Still Matters
episodesList.summary: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

episodesList.title: Rangan's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

episodesList.title: Healing and Breaking
episodesList.summary: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

episodesList.title: Emotion vs Ego
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

episodesList.title: Mind Over Momentum
episodesList.summary: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

episodesList.title: Deal with Divide
episodesList.summary: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

episodesList.title: The Cost of Pride
episodesList.summary: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

episodesList.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
episodesList.summary: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

episodesList.title: When Everything Falls Apart
episodesList.summary: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

episodesList.title: Dreams or Duty?
episodesList.summary: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

episodesList.title: Between Missing and Moving On
episodesList.summary: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

episodesList.title: When Silence Hurts
episodesList.summary: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

episodesList.title: Preparation and Crisis
episodesList.summary: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: MNCA Under Threat
episodesList.summary: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

episodesList.title: Renewed Hope
episodesList.summary: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

episodesList.title: Costly Clash
episodesList.summary: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

episodesList.title: Love in Fragments
episodesList.summary: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

episodesList.title: Weight of Staying
episodesList.summary: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Under Evaluation
episodesList.summary: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

episodesList.title: Before Impact
episodesList.summary: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

episodesList.title: Hearts Start to Align
episodesList.summary: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

episodesList.title: Shifting Equations
episodesList.summary: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Choice Within
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

episodesList.title: Shift in Play
episodesList.summary: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

episodesList.title: Words That Hurt
episodesList.summary: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

episodesList.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
episodesList.summary: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

episodesList.title: Parallel Hearts
episodesList.summary: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

episodesList.title: One Team, Many Battles
episodesList.summary: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

episodesList.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

episodesList.title: Beyond the Game
episodesList.summary: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

episodesList.title: Out of Sync
episodesList.summary: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

episodesList.title: Double Pressure
episodesList.summary: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

episodesList.title: What Makes a Team
episodesList.summary: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

episodesList.title: Us vs Them
episodesList.summary: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

episodesList.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
episodesList.summary: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

episodesList.title: When Life Demands More
episodesList.summary: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

episodesList.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
episodesList.summary: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

episodesList.title: A Legacy Reborn
episodesList.summary: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

title: Home Minister
summary: Home Minister is an Indian Marathi reality game show which aired on Zee Marathi. It began airing on 13 September 2004. It is Zee Marathi's first longest-running Indian television show in Marathi language.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: The format of the show consists of the host Aadesh Bandekar, visiting the homes of women in different cities of Maharashtra and playing various games with them. He is affectionately called "Bhauji" which translates to Brother-in-law. The show also has a segment where Aadesh Bandekar chat with the women and their families. At the end of every episode, the winner of the games receives Paithani saree from him.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Jitendra Joshi was replaced as the show's regular anchor in 2009 while Aadesh was contesting for the Maharashtra State Assembly election. He hosted the season Navvadhu No.1. In 2011, Nilesh Sable replaced Jitendra in 2011 and hosted the season Jaubai Jorat.
The series again premiered on 14 January 2011 replacing Sade Made Teen. The show stopped airing temporarily on 1 May 2010 with a total of 1616 episodes due to the Maharashtra State Election and it started again with new season.

title: Lukkhe
summary: Lukkhe is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime drama streaming television series created by Debojit Das Purkayastha and Agrim Joshi for the streaming platform Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Himank Gaur, the series stars Lakshvir Singh Saran, alongside the acting debut of singer-songwriter King (Arpan Kumar Chandel), Raashii Khanna, and Palak Tiwari. Set in Chandigarh, the narrative explores the intersections of the underground Punjabi hip hop industry, drug addiction, and organized crime networks. All eight episodes of the first season premiered concurrently on 7 May 2026.
plot:
The series follows Lucky, a promising hockey player who enters a rehabilitation centre following a severe accident stemming from substance abuse involving a synthetic narcotic named "Demon". While in recovery, he forms a relationship with another patient, Sanober. Upon release, Lucky discovers that Sanober's brother is Nihal Singh, known professionally as the underground hip-hop artist MC Badnaam, who utilizes his music operations to mask a narcotics distribution network.
Concurrently, Inspector Gurbani, a dedicated police officer investigating the spread of the drug cartel in Chandigarh, recruits Lucky to act as an undercover informant. The central plot details Lucky's infiltration of Badnaam's inner circle, which is further complicated by an ongoing, violent professional rivalry between Badnaam and a competing rapper, OG.
reception:
Writing for The Hollywood Reporter India, Rahul Desai called the series a "middling musical drama" that begins with a promising setup before lapsing into established subgenre clichés. However, Mehrotra highly commended the show's flamboyancy and visual craft, noting that the action sequences were kinetically choreographed and edited.
Trisha Gaur of Koimoi rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, stating that while the underlying premise of drug peddling in Punjab had potential, the narrative "turns into chaos in the finale." Gaur found the pacing sluggish and argued that the casting of the main characters felt mismatched for the dark atmosphere of the story.
Udita Jhunjhunwala of Scroll.in described the show as "overly ambitious" and overstuffed with tropes like corrupt police officers and comedic hitmen. Jhunjhunwala felt that the heavy focus on staging lengthy rap sequences occasionally diluted the plot's narrative urgency, though she credited the series for its sincerity regarding "biological ties and found family." A review by Moneycontrol echoed these criticisms, noting that coincidences did heavy lifting in the plot and that the overall tone felt "oddly polished" and sanitized, which stripped away the raw grit expected from an addiction-centric crime thriller. The reviewer did, however, praise Lakshvir Singh Saran for keeping his portrayal grounded and avoiding unnecessary flair.
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express characterized the series as erratic but engaging, observing that "when Lukkhe sticks to its own voice... it flies." Gupta praised the performances of the supporting cast, particularly Nakul Roshan Sahdev and Kritika Bharadwaj, as well as King's acting debut. Conversely, she criticized the writing for treating weightier themes like same-sex love and masculinity as mere afterthoughts, and noted that the Chandigarh setting often felt unconvincing and restricted to artificial sets.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: Following the release of the series, a FIR was registered in Chandigarh against actor Yograj Singh. The complaint, filed by a legal advocate, alleged that Singh's character delivered derogatory and anti-women remarks within the dialogue of the show. The Punjab State Commission for Women subsequently directed local police authorities to investigate the matter and submit an action taken report.

articleSections.title: Release and reception
articleSections.text: The first season consisting of eight episodes was made available globally on Amazon Prime Video on 7 May 2026.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Writing for The Hollywood Reporter India, Rahul Desai called the series a "middling musical drama" that begins with a promising setup before lapsing into established subgenre clichés. However, Mehrotra highly commended the show's flamboyancy and visual craft, noting that the action sequences were kinetically choreographed and edited.
Trisha Gaur of Koimoi rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, stating that while the underlying premise of drug peddling in Punjab had potential, the narrative "turns into chaos in the finale." Gaur found the pacing sluggish and argued that the casting of the main characters felt mismatched for the dark atmosphere of the story.
Udita Jhunjhunwala of Scroll.in described the show as "overly ambitious" and overstuffed with tropes like corrupt police officers and comedic hitmen. Jhunjhunwala felt that the heavy focus on staging lengthy rap sequences occasionally diluted the plot's narrative urgency, though she credited the series for its sincerity regarding "biological ties and found family." A review by Moneycontrol echoed these criticisms, noting that coincidences did heavy lifting in the plot and that the overall tone felt "oddly polished" and sanitized, which stripped away the raw grit expected from an addiction-centric crime thriller. The reviewer did, however, praise Lakshvir Singh Saran for keeping his portrayal grounded and avoiding unnecessary flair.

episodesList.title: Choices
episodesList.summary: Lucky faces survivor's guilt with the help of a new friend. Rapper Badnaam grows in infamy at Chandigarh, while calling out his rival 'OG'. Undercover cop Gurbani searches for the maker of a new drug 'Demon'. Their paths cross, setting up a collision course between Lucky and Badnaam one driven by love, the other fueled by hate.

episodesList.title: Trust
episodesList.summary: Lucky wins over Sanober's family. Badnaam drags Lucky into a dangerous plan to test his loyalty while a nemesis announces his comeback.

episodesList.title: Trauma
episodesList.summary: Knowing the bitter truth behind Badnaam and OG's fued distresses Lucky. Sanober fears abandonment. Assassians take a bounty on Badnaam's head and Lucky becomes an eye witness to Badnaam's carnage and true nature.

episodesList.title: Eye For An Eye
episodesList.summary: Gurbani confronts her past. Sanober gives Lucky a glimpse of her and Nihal's childhood and enduring bond revealing reasons behind their distrust of cops. Lucky begins gathering intel on the drug lab for Gurbani. The thrill of shooting Badnaam's first music video with 'the fam' falls under the evil eye of unhinged vengeance.

episodesList.title: Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: The attack on his life makes Badnaam a legend. The world knows his name. Gurbani makes her move for the drug lab. Lucky faces immense inner turmoil as Badnaam strikes a deal with the devil from his past.

episodesList.title: Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Nimmo suspects a leak in Badnaam's troupe, leading Badnaam to paranoia and action. Distrust creates walls between brothers. Lucky is designated as the drug courier to the college music festival where Sanober is to perform. A joyful moment shatters, painting Lucky's fate in black.

episodesList.title: Retribution
episodesList.summary: The college music festival becomes a battle of wits between Gurbani and Badnaam. Lucky and Sanober find themselves at the crossroads, having to choose between family and justice but an ace hides up someone's sleeve.

episodesList.title: Relapse
episodesList.summary: A concert in memoriam laced with undertones of dark justice. The final showdown sets in motion, a war between a Demon and a Devil while love, goodness and purity are reclaimed amidst turmoil and self destruction. No matter who wins, everyone loses.

plotHtml:
The series follows Lucky, a promising hockey player who enters a rehabilitation centre following a severe accident stemming from substance abuse involving a synthetic narcotic named "Demon". While in recovery, he forms a relationship with another patient, Sanober. Upon release, Lucky discovers that Sanober's brother is Nihal Singh, known professionally as the underground hip-hop artist MC Badnaam, who utilizes his music operations to mask a narcotics distribution network.
Concurrently, Inspector Gurbani, a dedicated police officer investigating the spread of the drug cartel in Chandigarh, recruits Lucky to act as an undercover informant. The central plot details Lucky's infiltration of Badnaam's inner circle, which is further complicated by an ongoing, violent professional rivalry between Badnaam and a competing rapper, OG.
tagline: Lucky navigates a treacherous world of addiction, recovery, and underground music as he infiltrates a drug cartel to save his soul.
